question: माझ्या जवळच्या कोणत्या गोदामात साठवलेल्या कृषी मालाचा विमा उतरवला जातो?
answer:
जवळच्या गोदामांची यादी खालीलप्रमाणे आहे. पण गोदामात साठवलेल्या कृषी मालाचा पीक विमा दावा कोणत्या अटीनुसार व प्रक्रियेत होतो याविषयी उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांमध्ये तपशील आढळला नाही.

**लोहा गोदाम**
पत्ता: एमएसडब्लूसी, एपीएमसी मार्केट यार्ड, शिवाजी चौक, लोहा
फोन: ९०२८५२१३३२
अंतर: १३.४ किमी

**नांदेड, मिडीसी गोदाम**
पत्ता: एमएसडब्लूसी, प्लॉट नंबर बी-१४, मिडीसी परिसर, नांदेड
फोन: ०२४६२-२२६५०७, ९१५८००१३३५
अंतर: १७.२ किमी

**पुर्णा गोदाम**
पत्ता: एमएसडब्लूसी, नांदेड रोड, पुर्णा
फोन: ०२४५२-२५५२१५, ९५४५०११६९३
अंतर: १८.८ किमी

**सिटी गार्डन, नांदेड गोदाम**
पत्ता: एमएसडब्लूसी, बसमत हिंगोली रोड, नांदेड
फोन: ०२४६२-२२४८२२
अंतर: १९.१ किमी

**बासमातनगर गोदाम**
पत्ता: एमएसडब्लूसी, बासमातनगर
फोन: ०२४५४-२२००८२
अंतर: २९.१ किमी

या गोदामांबद्दल साधारण माहिती मिळाली, पण साठवणुकीवर आधारित विमा दावा कुठे, काय कागदपत्रांसह आणि कुठल्या कालावधीत करता येतो हे तपशील सध्याची माहिती देऊ शकत नाही.

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती**

पत्ता: शासकीय आयटीआय कॉलेजच्या पुढाशी, महाडा कॉलनी, वरधा ४४२००१.
संपर्क: श्री एस.टी. साळुंखे
फोन: ९६०४८०८१३१
अंतर: २ कि.मी.

माती परीक्षणाची उपकरणे (डायरेक्ट हिंग) किंवा सेट रूपात देणारे स्वतंत्र केंद्र यात स्पष्टपणे नाही; पण खालील कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटरजवळूनही आपण चौकशी करू शकता:

**श्री गणेश स्वयं सहायता समूह (बहीगाव)**
पत्ता: बहीगाव, वरधा.
संपर्क: साधना प्रमोदराव धोपटे
फोन: ७७२१८६८४८८
अंतर: ९ कि.मी.

याशिवाय, जिल्हा मृदा सर्वेक्षण अधिकाऱ्यांना फोन करून मातीचा नमुना घेण्याचे नियम आणि रिपोर्ट काढणीबाबत त्वरीत माहिती मिळेल.

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती**

question: माझ्या कोणत्याही योजनेचा अर्ज ‘रद्द’ म्हणून चिन्हांकित केला आहे का? असल्यास, कारण काय आहे?
answer:
माझ्याकडे तुमच्या महाडीबीटी अर्जांची माहिती पाहिली. सध्या ३ एकूण अर्ज आहेत; त्यापैकी कोणत्याही योजनेचा अर्ज ‘रद्द’ म्हणून चिन्हांकित दिसत नाही.

- **अर्ज १:** कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण (सब-मिशन ऑन अग्रीकल्चरल मेकायनायझेशन) – स्थिती: बिल अपलोड करा
- **अर्ज २ व ३:** एका अज्ञात योजनेचे दोन भाग – स्थिती: प्रतीक्षा यादीत आहे (प्रतीक्षा यादीत आहे)

**रद्द काय आहे?**
- या संदर्भात सध्या ‘रद्द’ किंवा रद्द करणे कारण ही माहिती उपलब्ध नाही.

The protein [प्रथिने] sources are divided into two categories: 1) Vegetable protein [प्रथिने] supplements like soybean [सोयाबीन] meal [जेवण], ground nut oil cake, mustard [मोहरी]/ rapeseed [मोहरी] meal [जेवण], sesame [तीळ] meal [जेवण], sunflower [सुर्यफुल] meal [जेवण], safflower [करडई] meal [जेवण], cottonseed meal [जेवण], cluster bean [गवार] meal [जेवण], roasted cluster bean [गवार] meal [जेवण], rice [बासमती तांदूळ] gluten meal [जेवण], maize [मका] gluten meal [जेवण], dried distillery grains [धान्ये] with soluble, etc. and 2) Animal protein [प्रथिने] supplements like fish [मासे] meal [जेवण], meat [मांस] meal [जेवण], meat [मांस]-cum-bone meal [हाडांची भुकटी], blood [रक्त] meal [जेवण], liver meal [जेवण], feather meal [जेवण], etc. The feed that is to be formulated should have at least 3% oil to meet the requirement of essential fatty acids and for absorption of fat soluble vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे]. Moreover, preparation of high-energy diet requires supplementation of fat or oil. The feed intake is decreased with increased energy concentration in diets and thus better feed efficiency [चारा कार्यक्षमता] is obtained when fat is added. Fat also reduces heat increment especially in summer, reduces the toxicity of aflatoxins and tannins, fat has extra- calorific value [उष्मांक मूल्य], increases palatability of diet and facilities operation of feed meal [जेवण] and in pellet making. However, the cost of feed is increased as fats and oils are costlier. ``` ---- **Poultry Feed Region Specific** ``` Table 2. Nutrient [पोषक घटक] requirements for layers Considering the similarities in availability of feed ingredients, the country was divided in to ten geographic regions to formulate diets suitable for the specific region based on the available feed ingredients in the region so as to enable the poultry [कुक्कुट] farmers to utilize them in routine poultry [कुक्कुट] production [उत्पादन]. In all the major poultry [कुक्कुट] production [उत्पादन] regions, maize [मका], SBM and de-oiled rice [बासमती तांदूळ] bran [गहु-मका पाट] are usually included in poultry [कुक्कुट] diets when the price of these ingredients is reasonable. Therefore, formulations were made utilizing maize [मका]-soybean [सोयाबीन] meal [जेवण] and de-oiled rice [बासमती तांदूळ] bran [गहु-मका पाट] as standard diets, which can be utilized based on the price and availability. However, quite often the price of these prime ingredients escalates high and the availability and quality will become the major concerns. During such crises, replacement of these ingredients with the available alternate feed ingredients will reduce the cost of diets. Due to certain limitations (high fibre, plant chemical compounds, low digestibility, quality variations), total replacement of maize [मका] and SBM with the alternate ingredients is not possible and hence they were included as a partial replacers for maize [मका] and SBM. The number of alternate feed ingredients inclusion in the formula is not uniform among the regions. In some states, many alternate feed resources are available and inclusion of all the alternate feed ingredients in a single formula is not recommended. In such regions, more than one alternate feed formulations (options) were made. Such formulation can be chosen by the poultry [कुक्कुट] farmers based on the availability of feed ingredients in their specific region. The details of regions and availability of feed ingredients in the respective region are given in Table 3. Table 3. Region number, geographic states and availability of feed ingredients ``` ---- **Krushi VNMAU** ``` **Method of Taking Five Crops in Two Years: -** 1. question: Aata makka vikava ki kahi divas thambava?
answer:
मालेगाव (वाशिम) या जवळच्या बाजारात मकाचे भाव उपलब्ध नाहीत — सध्या सोयाबीनचेच भाव दिसले आहेत. 

मक्याची चांगली साठवण केली तर काही दिवस थांबणे शक्य आहे; मात्र बाजारातील ताजा भाव नसल्यामुळे निश्चित ठरवता येत नाही. आपल्या गाव/तालुक्याच्या एपीएमसीत सध्या मकाचा भाव उपलब्ध आहे का, हे स्पष्ट करा म्हणजे मी पुन्हा तपासेन?

**स्रोत: बाजारभाव**

आपल्याला कोणत्या ठिकाणाच्या बाजाराचा (गाव किंवा एपीएमसी नाव) भाव हवा आहे?

question: कोणती शेळीची जात जास्त वाढते?
answer:
वजनानुसार जास्त वाढ करणारी शेळीची जात म्हणजे **जामुनापरी**, कारण या जातीच्या नरांचे वजन ६० ते ९० किग्रा आणि मादीचे ५० ते ६० किग्रा असते.

**जामुनापरी:**  
- हे शेतकऱ्यांना चांगली दूध आणि मांस दोन्ही मिळवायला उपयोगी आहे.  
- दोन पिल्ले (ट्विन्स) एका वेळी येण्याचा दर सुमारे ३३ टक्के दर्शविला आहे.  

**अन्य भारी/मासासाठी ओळखल्या जाणाऱ्या जाती (कमी–मध्यम वजन):**  
- **बियाल:** नर ६० ते ९० किग्रा, मादी ५० ते ६० किग्रा असे वजन दिले आहे.  
- **सरोधी:** नर ५० किग्रा, मादी २५ किग्रा.  
- **उस्मानाबादी:** मोठे आकार, मांसासाठी ओळखले जातात; पण या दस्तऐवजात ठराविक वजन संख्या दिलेली नाही.  

**कोणती वाण निवडावी?** जामुनापरी किंवा बियाल निवडत असाल तर प्रजननासाठी सुधारित बक/मादी आणि योग्य चारा व्यवस्थापन केल्यास वजन वाढ चांगली होते, असे काही दस्तऐवजात सांगितले आहे.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ**, **स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी (डा. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली)**

The university has succeeded in developing a new improved breed [जाती] called 'Konkan Kanyal' by improving and purifying the selected goat [शेळी] breed [जाती].

Konkan Kanyal is a goat [शेळी] breed [जाती] mainly for meat production [मांस उत्पादन], and its mutton is excellent, delicious, and tasty. The mea t yield [उत्पादन] of 1- 1.5 year age old buck [शेळीचा नर] is 53.00 per cent. The weight of males of this breed [जाती] reaches 25 kg and females 21 kg in one year age. The birth weight of a kid [शेळीचे पिल्लू] is 2.23 kg for males and 2.05 kg for females. The weight of the kids up to 3 months of age is 9.00 kg and the weight of 6 months of growth [वाढ] is 14 to 15 kg. Also, the average weight of a fully grown buck [शेळीचा नर] is 50 kg, while the weight of a goat [शेळी] is up to 32 kg.

The reproductive capacity of the Konkan Kanyal goat [शेळी] is satisfactory. This goat [शेळी] becomes reproductive in the 11th month and comes into heat, and the first calving [व्याने] occurs in the 17th month. The rate of twinning is 40 per cent. The inter-kidding [शेळीच्या पिल्लांना जन्म देणे] period is eight months, and the goat [शेळी] kidding [शेळीच्या पिल्लांना जन्म देणे] three times in two years. The amount of milk [दूध] of this new breed [जाती] of goat [शेळी] is an average of 60 litres in each lactation, and the duration of lactation is 97 days. An average of 0.6 litres of milk [दूध] is obtained every day. The dry [कोरडे] period is 84 days. The mortality rate in goats is very low.
```

**Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**
```
1. **Goat [शेळी] (Bakari)**: 1) Jamnapari: This breed [जाती] is mainly found in the valleys of the Ganga, Yamuna, and Chambal rivers in Uttar Pradesh. This breed [जाती] is known for excellent milk [दूध] and meat [मांस]. The goats of this breed [जाती] are sturdy, agile, beautiful, tall, and white, yellowish in color. The male of this breed [जाती] weighs 60 to 90 kg and the female weighs 50 to 60 kg. This goat [शेळी] gives 600 liters of milk [दूध] in one calving [व्याने] (305 days). The rate of giving two kids (offsprings) at a time in this breed [जाती] is found to be 33 percent.

Males weigh 40 to 50 kg, and females weigh 35 to 40 kg. The color is white with black spots on the body. As the legs are short, they look stubby. Goats give two calvings in 15 months. These goats give birth to two or three kids (offsprings). These goats give an average of 1.5 to 2 liters of milk [दूध] per day. About 250 to 300 liters of milk [दूध] is obtained in one calving [व्याने].
3. **Black Bengal:** The goats of this breed [जाती] are found in West Bengal. Their meat [मांस] is of very good quality. Since the skin [त्वचा] is soft, there is a great demand for it in India and abroad. This breed [जाती] gives birth to two or three offsprings in one calving [व्याने]. The goats are black and copper [तांबे] in color. The average weight of the goat [शेळी] is 15 kg.
4. **Ajmeri (Sirohi):** This breed [जाती] is mainly found in Rajasthan and its surrounding areas. This breed [जाती] is good for meat production [मांस उत्पादन]. The goats of this breed [जाती] have a strong build and are of medium size. The color is light [प्रकाश] brown with large spots of dark brown color on it. The horns are medium in size and bent backward. Males weigh 50 kg while females weigh 25 kg.
5. **Osmanabadi:** Goats of this breed [जाती] are found in the Osmanabad area of Maharashtra. These are large in size and are known for meat [मांस]. They are black in color with large horns. White or copper [तांबे] color is also often found in this breed [जाती].
```

**Sheep Wool & Mutton Production and Value Addition**
```
India has promising native sheep [मेंढी] and goat [शेळी] breeds with average adult weight ranging from 30-40 kg, which holds promise for extensive selection to achieve improved birth weight that can yield [उत्पादन] better finishing weight at marketing. Some of the heavy breeds of sheep [मेंढी] and goats that promise maximum weaning weight are:

Sheep [मेंढी]: Muzafarnagari, Patanwadi, Malpura, Marwari, Nellore, Decani, Madras red, Mecheri Goat [शेळी]: Jamunapari, Jakhrana, Sirohi, Beetal, Boer, Osmanabadi, Malabari, Mehsana

rump sheep [मेंढी] that can also serve as a promising genotype [जनुकिय रचना] to yield [उत्पादन] maximum weight. Maximum weight of 135 kg is recorded in this sheep [मेंढी] with an encouraging birth weight of 4.0 kg. The tail fat serves as a reserve energy store for scarcity periods. These heavy breeds of sheep [मेंढी] and goats can be reared selectively for maximum finishing weight or can be introduced in planned breeding [प्रजनन] programmes for increasing birth weight of 'Maximizing Flock'.

5. **Osmanabadi:** Goats of this breed [जाती] are found in the Osmanabad area of Maharashtra. These are large in size and are known for meat [मांस]. They are black in color with large horns. White or copper [तांबे] color is also often found in this breed [जाती].

General Information Regarding Goat [शेळी] Breeding [प्रजनन]:

**Animal Science and Technology Standard XII**
```
7.6. Management [व्यवस्थापन] of poultry [कुक्कुट] according to season

7.6.1 Summer management [उन्हाळा काळातील व्यवस्थापन] : Intensive rearing of poultry [कुक्कुट] requires immediate and special attention and care during heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] in summer months. Heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] can inflict heavy losses by causing almost a total reduction in egg production [अंडे उत्पादन] and weight gain [वजन वाढ]. High yielding birds are highly susceptible to high temperature [तापमान] followed by high humidity [आर्द्रता].

Effect of high environment temperature [तापमान]

A. Rising temperature [तापमान] decreases

- 1. Feed intake
- 2. Egg production [अंडे उत्पादन]
- 3. Weight gain [वजन वाढ]
- 4. Thyroid size and activity
- 5. Blood [रक्त] calcium [कॅल्शियम] level

B. Rising temperature [तापमान] increase

- 1. Panting
- 2. Mortality
- 3. Feed conversion [आहार रूपांतरण] ratio [प्रमाण]
- 4. Water consumption
- 5. Respiration [श्वसन] rate
- 6. Body temperature [शरीराचा तापमान]

7. Stress

Following programme can be used at high temperature [तापमान] to make the birds more comfortable

- 1. Adequate floor space and no over- crowding
- 2. Give cool fresh water.
- 3. Increase the waterer space.
- 4. Give fresh food during the morning and evening cool hours.
- 5. Avoid feeding [खाऊ घालणे] in between 12 AM to 4 PM
- 6. Insulate the ceiling.
- 7. Increase ventilation [हवेची आदळ] by providing fans.
- 8. Use foggers.
- 9. Sprinkle the roof -run sprinklers intermittently.
- 10. Wet the area outside and around the house.
- 11. Use vitamin supplement A D3 E K, Vit C and electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] powder.
- 12. Increase protein [प्रथिने] level and decrease energy content in the feed to maintain protein [प्रथिने] intake.

Fig [अंजीर]. 7.10 : Panting of birds in heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]

 Fig [अंजीर]. 7.11 : Fogger [फॉगर] system

13. Painting the roof with white colour or thatching roof to reflect the heat to reduce the temperature [तापमान].
```

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
**Sangamneri Goat [शेळी]:** Goats of this breed [जाती] are found in Ahmednagar, Nashik, and Pune districts. Sangamneri goats are white in color, and some goats are whitish brown as well as black, black-striped, and red-striped. These goats are found to have horns that turn backwards in a curved manner or in other shapes. Also, to some extent there are also hornless goats. The proportion of twin kids in general goats is found to be 30 to 40 percent. It has been found that their weight gain [वजन वाढ] has improved by 12 to 15 percent by using improved breeding [प्रजनन] goats. All India Coordinated Sangamneri Goat [शेळी] Research Project and Sangamneri Goat [शेळी] Conservation Project are functioning at Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth for Sangamneri goats. This breed [जाती] is used for dual purposes of milk [दूध] and meat [मांस].  
Management [व्यवस्थापन]
```


----

**Krishi Darshani Dr BSKKV, Dapoli 2025**
```
Goat [शेळी] Reproduction: Goats generally come into heat at the age of 9 to 11 months. But age and weight are important here. The goat [शेळी] should have a body weight [शरीराचे वजन] of at least 25 to 30 kg. A female goat [शेळी] in the flock that has come into heat starts to bleat frequently. The vaginal area becomes swollen, and a red fluid comes out of it. At this time, she should be taken to a good buck [शेळीचा नर] for mating. If the farmer [शेतकरी] does not have a good buck [शेळीचा नर], artificial insemination [कृत्रिम गर्भाधारणा] should be used with the help of the local veterinary doctor. Mating the goats should be done properly. Pregnant goats should be kept separately and given enough feed and fodder [खाद्य आणि चारा] to eat. The gestation period [गर्भधारण कालावधी] of a goat [शेळी] is five months. Kids are born in the goat [शेळी] shed [निवारा] under supervision. After the kids are born, they should be given colostrumin to drink. The udder [कास] of the goat [शेळी] should be cleaned. The mother goat [शेळी] and the kids should be kept together. Proper care of the kids should be taken. Dewarmming should be done at regular intervals.

Since she is 14 to 16 months old and weighs 22 to 24 kg, it is more profitable to use her for breeding [प्रजनन]. Females can come into heat in any month of the year. Generally, females come into heat more often during March to June, and the chances of pregnancy [गरोदरपणा] are higher if they conceive during that period. Some goats only show heat but do not get pregnant. However, if there is a buck [शेळीचा नर] nearby, it can recognize such silent heat [मुका माज] properly, and it becomes easy to mate with them. That is why it is necessary to have a male in the goat [शेळी] herd [पशूंचे झुंड].
```


----

**Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**
```
10. Male sheep [मेंढी] and goats should be sold for meat [मांस] when they are 9 months old.
11. The leaves of the Giripushpa are an excellent nutritious fodder [पौष्टिक चारा] for sheep [मेंढी]. Sheep [मेंढी] can gain up to 42 grams of weight per day on fodder [चारा] alone.
12. As the leaves of Takala have excellent nutritional value [पौष्टिक मूल्य], the tender branches and leaves of Takala should be fed to goats.
13. Since the leaves of Apata are an excellent nutritious fodder [पौष्टिक चारा] for goats, they should be fed to them.
```

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
**Shrikhand:  
**First, prepare curd of 0.7 to 1 percent acidity [आम्लता] from milk [दूध]. Stir this curd well with the help of a spoon and tie it in a porous cloth. Then hang that cloth on a stand for 8 to 10 hours and let the sour water drain out of it. The white substance that remains in the cloth after the water has been drained out is called chakka. Mix 40 to 45 percent powdered sugar by weight in this chakka and add cardamom [वेलची], nutmeg [जायफळ] powder (1/4 teaspoon) to it for color and aroma [सुगंध] as required and mix it into the shrikhand pot. The shrikhand prepared in this way should be filled in plastic cups and stored at 5 degrees Celsius for further use.

**Goat [शेळी]  
**There are 10.60 million goats in Maharashtra. Maharashtra ranks fifth in India in terms of the number of goats and 15 lakh [लाख] families do goat [शेळी] rearing. Milk [दूध], meat [मांस], wool, leather, and manure [खत] are important things obtained from goats. Goats can survive in different climates. Considering its food and other needs, it can give a lot of production [उत्पादन] at a low cost.

**Goat [शेळी] Breeds  
**Goats of different colors and shapes are found in different parts of Maharashtra. Osmanabadi and Sangamneri breeds are mainly found in Maharashtra. There are a total of 28 breeds of goats in India. Among them, Beetal, Jamunapari, Sirohi, Barbari, Kutchi, Surati, etc., goats are mainly reared for milk [दूध]. An average of one to two liters of milk [दूध] can be obtained from these breeds every day. Fine quality wool called Pashmina and Mohair can be obtained from specific breeds of goats in cold climates.
```

question: जाई-जुईमध्ये ऑफ सीझन मध्ये फुले कशी आणावी?
answer:
ऑफ सीझनमध्ये झेंडू (जाई-जुई) फुले चांगली आणण्यासाठी नियमित आणि योग्य सिंचन व्यवस्थापन करणे अत्यावश्यक आहे.

**लागवड व ओळीचे व्यवस्थापन:** उन्हाळी झेंडू लागवड ठिबक सिंचनाखाली ३० ते ६० से.मी. × १५ से.मी. या ओळीच्या लागवडीवर करा, आणि जलवापर कार्यक्षमतेसाठी झाडांना दर इतर दिवशी पाणी द्या हे शिफारस केले आहे.

**सिंचन (ठिबक/शेडनेट):** अधिक उत्पादन व आर्थिक बाजूसाठी ऑगस्ट लावणीचा झेंडू ६५ × ३० से.मी. अंतराने ५०% सावली गुणांकाच्या शेड नेट हाऊसमध्ये लावा व प्रतिदिन ठिबकाने ८५% पाणी देणे शिफारस केले आहे.

**माती व हंगामाची निवड:** संकोच प्रदेशातील मध्यम खोल काळ्या मातीमध्ये उन्हाळी झेंडू व रब्बी ज्वारी एकत्र घेता येते; यामध्ये देखील झेंडूला ठिबकाने पाणी पुरवठा करा.

question: केळीचा घड कापणीसाठी तयार आहे हे कसे ओळखावे?
answer:
केळीचा घड कापणीसाठी तयार झाला आहे की नाही हे पुढील लक्षणांवरून ओळखता येते: घडातील फळांचा हिरवा रंग पिवळसर होणे आणि फळे गोल होणे.

**कापणीची वेळ:** लागवडीनंतर सुमारे २७० ते २८० दिवसांनी केळी फळधारण करू लागते; नंतर घडांना कापणीसाठी तयार होण्यास साधारण ९० ते ११० दिवस लागतात.  
**ओळखण्याचे निश्चित लक्षण:**  
- फळांचा रंग हिरवा ते पिवळसर बदलतो  
- फळे गोल दिसू लागतात  

**कापणी करताना सावधगिरी:**  
- घडाचा खोड लांब राहील असे कापणी करावी  
- घड कापल्यावर त्याच्या लेटॅक्स (कच्चा रस) फळांवर पडू देऊ नये, कारण त्यामुळे फळांवर डाग होतात  
- घड कापल्यानंतर माजी झाड लगेच कापावे  

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**

question: माझ्या शेतात ठिबक सिंचन (ड्रिप इरिगेशन) आणि तुषार सिंचन (स्प्रिंकलर) बसवण्यासाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे का?
answer:
माझ्याकडे तुमचा Agristack प्रोफाइल पाहिला, त्यात **जवळा (दे), लोहा, नांदेड** हे ठिकाण दिसले आहे आणि या ठिकाणासाठी पोक्रा/पोक्रा गावाची नोंद नाही. त्यामुळे पोक्रा अंतर्गत ठिबक व तुषार सिंचन योजनांसाठी तुम्ही पात्र नाही.

सध्या उपलब्ध माहितीनुसार खालील पर्याय आहेत:
- **पीएम-आरकेव्हीवाय-पर ड्रॉप मोअर क्रॉप (पीडीएमसी):** ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे जी ठिबक व तुषार सिंचन बसविण्यासाठी अनुदान देते; लहान व सीमान्त शेतकऱ्यांना किमान ५५% आणि इतर शेतकऱ्यांना ४५% ते कमाल ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत अनुदान दिले जाते.
- **राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण:** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी शेतीचे यंत्रसामग्री आणण्यासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य देते; साधारणपणे अनुदान ४०% किंवा ५०% (टप्पा व गटाप्रमाणे) या दराने किंवा मर्यादित रक्कमेत दिले जाते.
- **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (ठिबक सिंचन):** हा विभाग पोक्रा गावे फक्त असल्यासच लागू होतो.
- **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (तुषार सिंचन):** हा विभाग सुद्धा पोक्रा गावे फक्त असल्यासच लागू होतो.

तुमच्या प्रोफाइलमध्ये पोक्रा गावाची नोंद नसल्याने पोक्रा (पीएमसीआरए) अंतर्गत ठिबक आणि तुषार सिंचन योजनेसाठी पात्रता नाही. 

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुम्ही तुषार सिंचन, ठिबक सिंचन किंवा दोन्ही बसवू इच्छिता?

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
42

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-drip-irrigation

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

question: Fulkobimadhye Boron chi kamtarta kashi olakhavi?
answer:
फुलकोबीमध्ये बोरॉन कमतरता असेल तर नवीन शेंडे, कोंब आणि कोवळी पाने यांचे रंग पांढऱ्याकडे जाऊन ते वाळतात, पानावर सुरकुत्या (सरळ न राहणे) दिसतात व पिवळे डाग येतात; तसेच खोडावर भेगा लागतात व खोड चिकट/भुरकट होतो.

**लक्षणे:**
- झाडाच्या टोकाजवळील नविन शेंडे/कोंब देठाजवळून मरू लागतात व त्याचा रंग फिकट पडतो
- कोवळी पाने आणि कोंब निखळ पांढरे पडून मरतात
- पानावर सुरकुत्या येतात आणि पिवळे डाग दिसतात
- फळांवर लालसर ठिपके येतात व भेगा लावतात
- खोडावर भेगा दिसतात आणि खोड भुरकट/भारी (chikta/bhurat) बनतो

या सर्व लक्षणे एकत्रितपणे आढळली, तर बोरॉन कमतरतेची शक्यता जास्त असते.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शन (एमपीकेव्ही), डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, कृषी व्हिएनएमएयू**

आता फुलकोबीमध्ये हे लक्षण ज्या अवस्थेत दिसत आहेत ती सांगा—फलधारण सुरू आहे का किंवा रोपांची वेगळी वाढ थांबली आहे का?

question: माझ्या अर्जात कोणती कागदपत्रे राहिली आहेत आणि ती कधीपर्यंत द्यावी लागतील?
answer:
आता तुमच्या अर्जाची स्थिती "बिल अपलोड करा" (Invoice Upload) असल्यामुळे शेतकरी यांत्रिकीकरण उपयोजना/अंश-उपयोजना (Sub-Mission on Agriculture Mechanization, DDA) योजनेंतर्गत कागदपत्रांची आवश्यकता अशी आहे:

**अपेक्षित कागदपत्रे:**
- खरेदीसाठीचे कोटेशन (Implement to be purchase)
- यंत्रणाचा चाचणी अहवाल (Test report of the Implement)
- ट्रेक्टर चालित अवयवांसाठी ट्रेक्टरचा आर.सी. (RC of tractor for tractor driven implements)

**बिलाच्या स्थितीत लक्षात घ्या:** योजना माहितीत बिल अपलोड करण्यासाठी कधीपर्यंत द्यावे लागेल असा विशिष्ट कालावधी नमूद नाही; त्यामुळे कृती म्हणून महाडीबीटी अर्ज पोर्टलवर "Upload Invoice" भागात अधिकृत बिल (संपूर्ण भरावी रक्कम, ताऱ्हा, पावत्या क्रमांक इ.) तत्काळ अपलोड करणे योग्य राहील आणि शिल्लक कागदपत्रे पूर्ण ठेवावीत.

*Id*:
59

*Scheme Code*:
cdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
Sub-Mission on Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: माझ्या गावात काही पीक सुधारणा योजनेची नोंदणी कशी करावी?
answer:
कुंभारी (रेणापूर, लातूर) हे गाव पोक्रा-गावाच्या यादीमध्ये नसल्याने, पोक्रा अंतर्गत ठिबक/तुषार/फलोत्पादन लागवड या योजनांची सध्याची नोंदणी आपल्याला येथे करता येणार नाही. त्याऐवजी राज्य व केंद्र शासनाच्या पीक सुधारणा आणि अनुदान योजनांची ऑनलाईन नोंदणी करून घ्या.

**बाजारभाव:**
**डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (बी.ए.के.एस.वाई)** ही राज्य शासकीय योजना आहे.
**राज्य प्रोत्साहन कृषी यंत्रिकरण** ही राज्य शासकीय योजना आहे जी शेती यंत्रे व अवजारे खरेदीसाठी अनुदान देते; शेतकऱ्यांना खुले बाजार निवडून कागदपत्रे अपलोड करावी लागतात आणि अनुदान थेट बँक खात्यात जमा होते.
**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी योजना (पीएम-किसान)** ही केंद्र शासकीय योजना आहे.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- **बी.ए.के.एस.वाई** साठी महाडीबीटी संकेतस्थळावर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करावा लागतो; ज्या तालुक्यातील विहित मर्यादेत लाख अर्ज प्राप्त होतात त्या पैकी प्रथम आलेला-पहिल्या मिळण्याचे स्वरूपानुसार योग्य पात्रतापूर्ण अर्ज निवडले जातात.
- **राज्य प्रोत्साहन कृषी यंत्रिकरण** साठी महाडीबीटी संकेतस्थळावर अर्ज करण्यात येतो; इच्छित अवजाऱ्याचा भावानंतर क्वोटेशन, यंत्राचा चाचणी अहवाल आणि ट्रॅक्टर चालित अवजारे असल्यास ट्रॅक्टरची आर.सी. आवश्यक आहे.
- **पीएम-किसान** साठी पीएम-किसान संकेतस्थळावर ऑनलाईन नोंदणी करावी लागते.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला सिंचन सुधारणा, शेती यंत्रे खरेदी, कीटक रोग व्यवस्थापन किंवा हवामान-आधारित पिकांसाठी कोणत्या प्रकारच्या योजनेची नोंदणी हवी आहे?

*Scheme Code*:

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

- अकोला गोदाम, पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, नन-६६, फेज-४, मिडीसी आरिया, शिवनी, अकोला, अंतर: ७.७११ किमी

- तेल्हरा गोदाम, पत्ता: एमएसडब्ल्यूसी, एस.टी. डेपो मागे, तेल्हरा, अंतर: ३८.७५८८ किमी, संपर्क क्रमांक: ०७२५८-२३१२२८

question: अहमदनगर बाजारात गहू सध्या किती भावाने चालतोय?

question: Perumadhye gutikalama karnyachi paddhat kay aahe?
answer:
कडधान्यातून गूटिकामध्ये करणे (डाळ तयार करणे) हे लघु/गृह उद्योग स्वरूपात मिनी डाळ मिल मशिन वापरून करता येते आणि तूर, मूग, चणा यांपासून ५० ग्रॅम ते १ किग्रॅ पॅकिंगमध्ये डाळ विकता येते; शेतकऱ्यांना कमी भांडवलात संपूर्ण प्रक्रियासाठी साफ-गोठवा, गोठवा फोडणे, कडधान्ये वरंबीने चांगली जादाळ तयार करणे, भुसा व पावडर वेगळे करणे अशी यंत्रसामग्री उपलब्ध आहे.

**प्रक्रिया पद्धत:**
- डाळ बनवण्याचा उद्योग — घरगुती स्तरावर तूर, मूग, चणा यांतील कडधान्ये वापरून मिनी डाळ मिल मशिनच्या मदतीने करावा; बाजारात आजही मिनी डाळ मिल मिळते.
- महिलांचे स्वरोजगार धोरण — ५० ग्रॅम ते १ किग्रॅ पॅकिंगमध्ये डाळ तयार करून विक्री सुरू करता येते.
- मिनी डाळ मिलची क्षमता (घरगुती प्रकार, डी.पी.के.वी.) — ३५ ते ४० किग्रॅ/तास आणि अधिक क्षमतेचे आणखी मोडेल्स आहेत; संपूर्ण प्रक्रियेत डाळ, चुरी, भुसा आणि पूड वेगवेगळे करता येतात.

**स्रोत: कृषी विद्यापीठांची दस्तऐवज माहिती (कृषी विष्णूमाऊ, डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ)**

आपल्याला कोणत्या कडधान्याची (हरभरा/तूर/मूग/उडीद) डाळ तयार करायची आहे?

## The challenge

These crops have an integral role in the sustainability of hill agriculture [शेती] as well as in providing livelihood and food security [अन्न सुरक्षा] to the millions of rural inhabitants. question: टरबूज पिकात जास्तीत जास्त फुले लागण्यासाठी काय करावे?
answer:
टरबूज पिकात जास्तीत जास्त फुले आलीं की उत्तर काढणीचाही चांगला नफा मिळतो; यासाठी मातीची तयारी, योग्य खत मात्रा आणि पाण्याच्या व्यवस्थापनावर भर द्या.  

**माती:** मध्यम तांबडी, उत्तम निचरा असलेली माती निवडा; शेतामध्ये पाणी साठणार नाही याची काळजी घ्या.  

**खत व्यवस्थापन:**  
- शेणखत १५ टन प्रति हेक्टर द्या.  
- नत्र १५० किलो, स्फुरद ५० किलो, पालाश ५० किलो प्रति हेक्टर द्या (हा प्रकार).  
- हायब्रीड प्रकारासाठी नत्र ५० किलो, स्फुरद १०० किलो, पालाश १०० किलो प्रति हेक्टर द्या (आणि शेणखत २० टन प्रति हेक्टर).  
हे शिफारसी उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांनुसार आहेत; तुमचे लागवड वाण किंवा हायब्रीड/नांदवी यावरून एकमेक वेगळे दिसते.  

**पाणी व सिंचन:** थंडीत सूर्यप्रकाशाचे धक्के कमी करण्यासाठी लाल रंगाचे ५०% छाया जाळीचे शेड नेट हाऊस, त्यात दररोज पिकाचे वाष्पीकरण व वाष्पोत्सर्जन १००% पूर्ण करणारे सिंचन आणि ४० मायक्रॉन जाडीचे चांदी–काळा प्लास्टिक आच्छादन वापरल्याने उच्च उत्पादनासाठी मदत होते असे दस्तऐवज सूचित करतात.  

**इतर व्यवस्थापन:** प्लास्टिक आच्छादन आणि ठिबक सिंचन वापरल्यास पाण्याची बचत, तण नियंत्रण आणि उत्पादनात वाढ दिसते, म्हणून फुलांची संख्या आणि फलधारणा दोन्ही मजबूत करण्यासाठी ही पद्धत उपयोगी ठरते.  

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शन डॉ. बाबासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**, **कृषी दर्शन (एम.पी.के.व्ही.)**, **कृषी वैज्ञानिक माहिती मार्गावली (एन.बी.ई.टी.)**

तुमचे टरबूज हिरवा/हायब्रीड प्रकार आहे की सामान्य नांदवी? त्यानुसार खताची मात्रा आणि पद्धत मी नेमकी लिहून देतो.

### **Fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] Technology for Orchards and Vegetables (Methods of Applying Soluble Fertilizers)**

Fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] is the process of giving fertilizers to crops in liquid form or soluble in water through micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] or drip irrigation system [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली]. For delivering soluble fertilizers to crops through micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] systems, fertilizer [खत] tanks, venture, and injection pumps etc. are mainly used.

**Venturi:** The venturi is a dumb-bell shaped device with a decreasing diameter in the middle, which increases the flow rate of water and reduces the available pressure in the middle of the venture, allowing the fertilizer [खत] to be available through the manifold during irrigation [सिंचन]. Given on the ground through drips. The water in the fertilizer tank [खत साठवण टाकी] should be mixed and then the pipe coming out of that tank should be left in the venturi. After starting the drip irrigation system [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली], if both the control valves are started, the fertilizers from the tank are absorbed/drawn through the venturi and mixed with the water flow in the pipe of the system and released through the dripper on the manifold or in the area of the roots of the trees/crops.

**Sudden Wilt Disease [मररोग]**

Symptoms [लक्षणे]: If the daytime temperature [तापमान] remains above 380 C for a long time as well as water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] occurs and if water accumulates in the field [शेत] during the rainy season, it has an adverse effect on the physiology of cotton [कापूस]. Due to water stress [पाण्याचा ताण], water vessels that absorb nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] become swollen and the pipes close. Leaves, flowers and bolls of the plant do not get nutrient [पोषक घटक] supply, the radiance of the leaves disappears and the leaves turn yellow. The leaves, flowers and bolls are shed [निवारा] and the plant dies.  
Remedy: 1) Plant summer irrigated Bt cotton [बीटी कापूस] from the second fortnight of May to the first week of June and water it at an interval of 8 to 15 days.  
2) Take care that water will not accumulate in the crop [पीक] and drain the accumulated water immediately. 3) As soon as the symptoms [लक्षणे] appear on the deformed plants, apply 1.5 kg Urea [यूरिया] + 1.5 kg Muriate of Potash 150 to 200 ml in 100 liters of water. 4) After that, mix 2 kg DAP in 100 liters of water and pour this solution near the stump of the plant at 150 to 200 ml after 8-10 days and water immediately.

### **Diseases and Their Management [व्यवस्थापन] in Pigeon Pea [तूर] (Tur)**

Growth [वाढ] of the fungus is visible within. Sometimes, white fungus is also found on the stem.

**Management [व्यवस्थापन]:** Follow long-term crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट]. Sow [मादी डुक्कर] disease [रोग]-resistant varieties [प्रतिकारक वाण]. - जास्त उतारावर व/किंवा झिरपण्याच्या क्षमतेने कमी असलेली जमीन असल्यास (५ ते १०% उतार) बांधांची अंतर सुमारे ३ मीटर ठेवल्यास पावसाचे अतिरिक्त पाणी हळूवारपणे बाहेर जाते आणि जमीनधुका कमी होते.

**दोन बांधांच्या मध्ये काय करावे:**
- दोन बांधांच्या दरम्यान लागवडीत उताराच्या उलट दिशेने सरी (फरांग) तयार केल्यास पेरणीच्या वेळी रीडज-फरांग पद्धतीने पाऊसपाणी शेतातच थांबते.

**वर्गीकृत बांध (जास्त पाऊस/झिरप कमी):**
- प्रत्येक वर्षी ६०० मिमी पेक्षा जास्त पाऊस आणि मध्यम ते भारी जमीन असल्यास वर्गीकृत बांध करावेत, त्यामुळे वेगाने वाहणारे पाऊसपाणी नियंत्रणात येते आणि माती धुका कमी होते.

**जीवबांध (सुकी/आरोग्यदायी बांध):**
- समोच्चरेषेवर वाळा गवत किंवा नापर/इतर डीप–रूटेड गवताचे जीवबांध लावल्यास हा नैसर्गिक आरोग्यदायी बांध होतो; त्यामुळे वर्षभर गवताने पाणी धरून धरते.

**स्रोत: MPKV कृषी दर्शनी**, **स्रोत: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**

आपल्या शेताचा अंदाजे उतार किती टक्के आहे आणि पाऊस साधारणपणे इतका मिळतो (कमी की जास्त) हे सांगा—याप्रमाणे बांधांचे अंतर व प्रकार निश्चित करायला मदत करू.

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
**Principles of Rainfed Farming [कोरडवाहू शेती]**

1. **Land Leveling [जमीन समतलीकरण]:** Soil [माती] particles and nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] are washed away with rainwater from sloping land, reducing soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता]. If the land is leveled, soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] is maintained due to reduced soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप]. Also, moisture is stored in the soil [माती] and helps in stabilizing the yield [उत्पादन] with good crop [पीक] growth [वाढ].
2. **Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] and Sowing [पेरणी] in Contour:** As the ploughing [नांगरणी], harrowing [वखरणी], and sowing [पेरणी] of the soil [माती] is done in contour, the rainwater flowing over the soil [माती] does not go to waste, but more water is absorbed into the soil [माती], and this helps in uniform crop [पीक] growth [वाढ].
3. **Bund Construction and Inter-Bund Management [व्यवस्थापन]:** By constructing bunds in the soil [माती] along the contour, rainwater is blocked and soil [माती] particles, nutrients [पोषक तत्वे], and moisture carried away by the soil [माती] are helped to be stored in the soil [माती], which increases the yield [उत्पादन]. While cultivating the soil [माती] between two bunds, by putting furrows transverse to the slope, ridge and furrow [सरी व वरंबा] cultivation helps to retain rainwater in the soil [माती] on the spot.
4. **Crop Planning [पीक नियोजन] According to Soil [माती] Depth:** Due to varying soil [माती] depths, the capacity to store moisture in the soil [माती] varies. Different crops require different amounts of water. As per the soil [माती] depths given in Table No. 1, recommendations have been made for the crops. By planning the crop [पीक] accordingly, it will help in stabilizing the yield [उत्पादन] during drought [दुष्काळ] years.  
    a) In the drought [दुष्काळ] prone area, Kharif sunflower [सुर्यफुल] should be sown on medium deep soil [माती] (45 to 60 cm) between 9 to 15 July and Rabi sunflower [सुर्यफुल] should be sown on medium deep soil [माती] (60 to 90 cm) in the month of September.  
    b) For sustainable production [उत्पादन] in drought [दुष्काळ] prone area, Tur should be sown in medium deep soil [माती] (45 to 60 cm) between 1 to 15 July.  
    c) Rabi Sorghum [ज्वारी] should be sown in medium to deep soil [माती] in the drought [दुष्काळ] prone area of western Maharashtra between 15 September to 15 October.
```


----

**Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**
```
1. **Contour Cropping:** Planting crops always across the slope (preferably at the same level) helps the rainwater to percolate evenly over the entire area. Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] across the slope prevents rainwater from flowing out of the field [शेत] quickly, and the ridges created by tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] slow down its speed and allow it to seep into the field [शेत]. This type of crop [पीक] pattern is called contour cropping. This method must be implemented when the slope of the farmland is more than one percent. Placing guide contour bunds (of khus or other grass) at regular intervals provides direction for sowing [पेरणी] and other tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] operations, and allows more rainwater to seep into the soil [माती].
2. **Soil [माती] Conserving Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत]:** Proper interculture of the crop [पीक] during the growing season keeps the soil [माती] loose and increases the process of rainwater percolation [पाझरण]. If a furrow [सरी] is created between two crop [पीक] rows by tying a rope [दोरी] to the drag of a cultivator [कल्टिव्हेटर (नांगरणीचे अवजार)] during such interculture, it helps to store excess water and seep it into the field [शेत] itself, and the crop [पीक] benefits from it. At the same time, deep plowing [खोल नांगरणी] should be done every 3 to 4 years so that a hard crust is not formed below the surface.
3. **Bund Construction:** In low rainfall areas (up to 600 mm) in light [प्रकाश] and medium soils up to 1 to 6 percent slope, water flowing between two bunds is prevented and seeped into the upper side of the contour bund [समपातळी बांध]. When the annual rainfall is more than 600 mm and the soil [माती] is medium to heavy, diversion bunds should be constructed instead of contour bunds, giving some specific slope (up to 0.2 to 0.6 percent). These bunds control the fast-flowing rainwater and slowly release it out of the field [शेत]. Since this type of bund construction takes time for rainwater to flow out of the field [शेत], it helps to seep some amount of water into the field [शेत] and reduces soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप]. The distance between the two bunds should be kept 60 to 70 meters for a 2 to 3 percent slope.
```


----

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
## **Soil [माती] and Water Conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन]**

**Approximately 82% of the area in Maharashtra is rainfed. Of the rainfall in this area, 30 to 40% of the water percolates into the ground, 20 to 30% evaporates back into the atmosphere, and 30 to 50% flows away as runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी]. This runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] causes soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] of 5 to 20 tons per hectare at various places. It is necessary to carry out soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] works on a large scale with governmental, non-governmental (NGO), and public participation, as well as at the farmers' level, to stop this runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] and use it for protective irrigation [संरक्षक सिंचन], as well as to control soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप]. Especially, farmers should adopt the following methods of in-situ soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] on their farms. This will definitely increase production [उत्पादन] through good water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] and will control soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप].**

**1\. Contour Bunds:**

**Contour bunds help to stop the flowing water and allow it to percolate into the soil [माती]. These treatments are beneficial in low rainfall areas such as Nandurbar, Dhule, Ahmednagar, Nashik, Solapur, Pune, and some parts of Sangli districts, as well as on land with slopes of up to 3%. If the rate of water infiltration [पाणि झिरपण्याची क्षमता] into the soil [माती] is high and rainfall is low, contour bunds of 30 cm height should be prepared and the distance between two bunds should be kept at approximately 5 meters. This treatment [उपचार] keeps the moisture level uniform throughout the field [शेत], and production [उत्पादन] increases by 10%, as observed in experiments at Rahuri, Solapur, and Dhule.**

**2\. Graded Bunds:**

**In high rainfall areas with land slopes of 5 to 10%, as well as in places where the rate of water infiltration [पाणि झिरपण्याची क्षमता] is low, triangular shaped graded bunds of 30 cm height and 0.6% grade should be constructed about 3 meters apart for soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन]. This type of bunds allows excess water to be drained out of the field [शेत] at a slow rate, which reduces soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप]. Also, the systematic percolation [पाझरण] of water in the field [शेत] increases production [उत्पादन] by 5 to 15%.**

**3\. Broadbeds and Furrows:**
```

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
1. **Planting Agave:** In light [प्रकाश] soils (up to 22.5 cm deep) in rainfall zone No. 4 (Osmanabad, Solapur, Latur, Beed, Nagar, Aurangabad, Dhule, Jalgaon) in the drought [दुष्काळ]-prone region, planting agave at a distance of 2x1 m provides 6 tons of green leaf production [उत्पादन] per hectare per year after the third year, and 3 to 3.5 quintals of fiber is obtained from it. Also, intercropping [आंतरपीक] stylo grass in agave provides eight to ten tons of green fodder [हिरवा चारा] per hectare per year in three to four cuttings [कापणी टप्पे].
2. **Biological Bunds:** Soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] is reduced by constructing biological bunds of subabul [सुबाभळ] on contour lines at a distance of 16 to 18 meters according to the slope of the land. The soil texture [जमीनीचा पोत] improves, moisture is retained in the soil [माती], and production [उत्पादन] increases. Applying 5 metric tons per hectare of green foliage and tender branches of subabul [सुबाभळ] from such bunds to the soil [माती] increases the level of nitrogen [नत्र] in the soil [माती] by 25 kg per hectare.

For water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन], higher production [उत्पादन] of Rabi sorghum [ज्वारी], and convenient tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] in the drought [दुष्काळ]-prone region of Maharashtra, Zone 1 and 4, with 2% slope and medium depth soils, a three-row biological bund of _Mattras Anjan_ grass with 15 cm distance is recommended at a distance of 15 to 30 meters on the contour line.
```


----

**Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**
```
**Dryland Farming [कोरडवाहू शेती] and Agro-Climatic Research**

**In-Situ Conservation [इन सीटू संवर्धन] of Rainwater:** Since the production [उत्पादन] of dryland crops depends only on rainwater, the following techniques should be adopted to maximize the infiltration [झिरपणे] of rainwater into the soil [माती].

1. Develop one or two biological bunds of Khas or other grasses on the contour in the field [शेत] and cultivate and sow [मादी डुक्कर] the crops parallel to them. This technique stops soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप], conserves rainwater in situ in higher amounts and increases the yield [उत्पादन] by ensuring uniform growth [वाढ] of the crops.
2. To conserve soil [माती] and water as well as to ensure good drainage of excess water, make Sanya with the help of a hoe [डवरा] (davar) after every two rows 30 to 35 days after sowing [पेरणी] in the crop [पीक].
3. To ensure sustainable production [उत्पादन] and soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन], instead of taking only cotton [कापूस] crop [पीक] in sloping fields, take soybean [सोयाबीन] crop [पीक] in the lower 30 percent area and take gram [हरभरा] as a duhar crop [पीक] if there is moisture in the soil [माती] after removing soybean [सोयाबीन].
4. If a biological bund is developed in the middle of two bunds in a well-bunded field [शेत], the cost of maintaining the bunds is reduced and soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] is done well.
5. For improving the efficiency of rainwater, productivity and soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] in dryland sorghum [ज्वारी] crop [पीक], it is recommended to reduce tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] (one harrowing [वखरणी] followed by weeding [तण काढणे]) and to apply 20:40:40 nitrogen [नत्र], phosphorus [स्फुरद] and potash / hectare through chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] and 20 kg nitrogen [नत्र] through manure [खत] (3.8 tons/ha.) and the remaining 20 kg nitrogen [नत्र] through chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] and 20 kg through leaves of Giripushpa (3 tons per hectare) after 30 days.
6. For Western Vidarbha, a farm pond [शेततळे] of size 18 × 18 × 3 meters with a side slope of 1:5:1 is recommended in medium deep black soil [काळी मृदा] with a slope of 1 percent on average, with a protective irrigation [संरक्षक सिंचन] of 5 cm with sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन] during Kharif and Rabi to provide 1 hectare area.

**Crops and Cropping Systems:** Select crops according to soil [माती] depth and moisture content [आर्द्रता].
```

**Krushi VNMAU**
```
There may be a difference of more or less 4 to 5 days in the above period. Intercropping system [आंतरपीक पद्धत] should be adopted as far as possible in contingency crop planning [पीक नियोजन]. If there is continuous rain in the month of October in Rabi season [रबी हंगाम] or there is no suitable condition for sowing [पेरणी], Rabi crops [रब्बी पिके] can be taken up to 30th October.

**Soil [माती] and Water Conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन]:**

Appropriate methods of conserving rainwater in-situ in dryland farming [कोरडवाहू शेती] mainly come under the types related to vegetation management [व्यवस्थापन] and soil tillage [जमिनीची मशागत]. In vegetation management [व्यवस्थापन] and methods, contour tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] and sowing [पेरणी], intercropping [आंतरपीक] methods and biological bunding, and in soil tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] methods, water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] furrow [सरी] / dead furrow [सरी], furrow [सरी] after a certain row in standing crops, ridge [वरंबा]-furrow [सरी], close furrow [सरी], and broad bed furrow [रुंद बेड आणि सरी], close-check basin [लहान भागांमध्ये विभागलेले थाळ सिंचन] are included.

**Intercropping System [आंतरपीक पद्धत]:**

In dryland farming [कोरडवाहू शेती], the adoption of intercropping [आंतरपीक] methods is useful for soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] along with sustainable production [उत्पादन] and higher economic income. After other tillage methods [मशागत पद्धती] mentioned above, intercropping [आंतरपीक] methods perform the function of soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन]. Intercropping [आंतरपीक] methods recommended by Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Agricultural University, Cotton [कापूस] + Moong/Udid/Soybean [सोयाबीन] (1:1), Sorghum [ज्वारी] + Tur (4:2), Bajra [बाजरी] + Tur (3:3) and Rabi Sorghum [ज्वारी] + Safflower [करडई] (6:3) should be adopted.

**Biological Bunding:**

The barrier in the line created by the plants at the contour line of the area, generally at a short distance from the soil [माती] bund, is called the biological bund. For the construction of biological bunds, plants that produce humus [ह्युमस] or pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] grass should be used. About 25 to 30 meters apart, in two rows 15 to 20 cm apart, the selected plants should be planted in monsoon [पावसाळा]. The bund is formed in 1 to 2 years depending on the type of plant. By pruning [फांद्या छाटणी] from time to time, the height and width of the bund should be kept at 30 to 40 cm. The products of biological bund pruning [फांद्या छाटणी] are used in crops for mulching [आच्छादन], as organic [सेंद्रिय] nutrient [पोषक घटक] sources, or for animal feed [जनावरांचे खाद्य]. Among biological bunds, the Vetiver [वाळा] grass bund is more efficient in all types of soil [माती] and climatic areas.

**Water Conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] Trench:**
```

**Krushi VNMAU**
```
Along with these protective and developmental measures of soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन], the following improved technology-related aspects should be adopted at the farm level.

1. Planting crops according to the classification of land.
2. Contour cultivation as well as biological bunding.
3. Adopting strip cropping [पट्टा शेती] method.
4. Conserved tillage [जमिनीची मशागत].
5. Agroforestry [कृषिवनशास्त्र], horticulture [उद्यानविद्या], and pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] development.
6. Proper crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट].
7. Using high-quality seeds, fertilizers, and crop protection [पीक संरक्षण] measures.
8. Using protected irrigation [सिंचन] for dryland crops.

It is necessary to properly manage the water available in the watershed by using drip or sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन] methods. The participation of the people in the watershed is very important for the success of the watershed development program. The watershed development program can be successfully implemented through the participation of local people. The costly items of the watershed development program are treated by the government through various campaigns or financial assistance is given to the farmers for some items. If the watershed development program is successfully implemented, the people in that area will benefit from it in many ways. The measures of soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] increase the water storage [साठवण] in the watershed. So that along with the comprehensive development of the rural people, the problem of drinking water [पाणी पिणे] can be solved, as well as more area can be brought under irrigation [सिंचन]. The economic condition of the farmers can be improved and their standard of living can be improved by increasing their agricultural production [उत्पादन]. Watershed development program is not limited to the objectives of implementing soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] measures, but it is an ambitious program to bring about the comprehensive development of the people living in the watershed.

Farm ponds are useful for storing rainwater flowing in the fields. The water stored in farm ponds is used for irrigation [सिंचन], to meet the drinking water [पाणी पिणे] needs of animals, and for fisheries [मत्स्यव्यवसाय]. In times of temporary drought [दुष्काळ], crops that are drying [वाळवणे] up due to lack of rain are saved by giving water from farm ponds. While selecting a place for farm ponds, such a place should be selected so that all the water from the farm will collect in that selected place.

Regarding the size of the farm ponds, according to the studies conducted at Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Agricultural University, the following sizes of farm ponds have been determined.
```


----

**Krushi VNMAU**
```
**Objectives of Watershed Development Program**

1. To reduce soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] caused by the flow of water over the land.
2. To percolate the rainwater that falls in the watershed area into the soil [माती].
3. To store the rainwater flowing from the land in the watershed at appropriate places.
4. To increase the groundwater storage [साठवण] in the watershed, to plant trees by digging ditches on sloping and barren lands.
5. To make efficient use of the water stored in the watershed.
6. To improve the degraded land in the watershed.
7. To maintain the balance of the environment in the watershed.
8. To improve the economic development of the people in the watershed and raise their living standards.

In order to achieve the various objectives of the watershed development program, the following measures of soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] should be adopted according to the need, taking into account the land, crops, cropping systems, geology, streams, drains, etc. in the watershed.

1. Contour bunding [समोच्च बंधारे].
2. Graded bunding.
3. Terracing in highly sloping hilly areas.
4. Planting trees by digging ditches on sloping and barren lands.
5. Carrying out temporary or permanent treatments for gully control.
6. Creating farm ponds, village ponds, percolation [पाझरण] tanks, etc. for water storage [साठवण].
7. Nala straightening and nala bunding.
8. Building subsurface barriers.

Along with these protective and developmental measures of soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन], the following improved technology-related aspects should be adopted at the farm level.

1. Planting crops according to the classification of land.
2. Contour cultivation as well as biological bunding.
3. Adopting strip cropping [पट्टा शेती] method.

3.2 Contour farming [समतल शेती]

Contour farming [समतल शेती] involves planting crops in horizontal rows along the natural contours of a slope. Its applications are mainly in the hilly agroecosystems and sloppy lands (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.1). All operations are performed along the contour line.

The success of these practices depends on rainfall patterns, soil [माती] characteristics, and land topography. The benefits of this are as below:

3.2.1 Runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] and erosion management [व्यवस्थापन]: Constructing ridges and furrows along the contour slows down water flow, minimizing runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] and preventing soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप]. Additionally, it helps retain essential nutrients [पोषक तत्वे], thereby reducing their loss from the soil [माती].

Figure 3.1: Contour Farming [समतल शेती]

- 3.2.2 Soil Moisture [मातीचा ओलावा] Conservation: In regions with low rainfall, contour farming [समतल शेती] enhances water infiltration [पाणि झिरपण्याची क्षमता], promoting moisture retention [ओलावा टिकवून धरणे]. In high rainfall areas, it prevents excessive soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] and runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी].
- 3.2.3 Soil Fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] and Crop Yield Improvement [पीक उत्पादन सुधारणा]: Preserves soil nutrients [मृदा अन्नद्रव्य] and moisture, contributing to better crop [पीक] growth [वाढ] and productivity.

A step-by-step guide to execute contour farming [समतल शेती] while doing NF is given below.

- Preparation: Mark contour lines using an A-frame or laser level.
- Recommended Crops:
 - Contour Bunds: Vetiver [वाळा] grass, napier, citronella (deep-rooted, prevent erosion).

question: ठिबक सिंचनाद्वारे सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये देण्याची सर्वोत्तम पद्धत कोणती?
answer:
ठिबक सिंचनाद्वारे सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये देण्याचा वैज्ञानिक उपाय म्हणजे फर्टीगेशन — म्हणजे पाण्यासोबत विरघळणारी खते/अन्नद्रव्ये ड्रीपरमधून थेट मुळांच्या भागात सोडणे. या पद्धतीत खत साठवण टाकी, व्हेंटुरी किंवा इन्जेक्शन पंप वापरून खताचा द्रावण सिंचन प्रणालीच्या पाण्यात मिसळले जाते आणि सगळ्या रोपांना समान प्रमाणात पोहोचते.

**पद्धत:**
- **विरघळणारी खते:** ठिबक सिंचनासाठी पाणीत पूर्णपणे विरघळणारी (वाटर सॉल्यूबल) खतांची निवड करा; द्रवाच्या किंवा घट्ट स्वरूपातील खते पाण्यात नीट कळकळ मिश्रण करून टाकीत भरा.
- **इंजेक्शन उपकरणे:** खत टाकीमधून आलेला पाइप व्हेंटुरीमध्ये टाका; सिंचन सुरू होऊन दोन नियंत्रण वाल्वे उघडल्यावर व्हेंटुरीच्या दाबाखाली खत द्रावण पाइपमध्ये हवेसारखे ओढले जाते, मुख्य पाइपमध्ये मिसळते आणि ड्रीपरमधून रोपांना दिले जाते.
- **दाब व गाळणी:** ड्रीपर योग्य कार्य करण्यासाठी लाटेरलमध्ये १५ ते २० मीटर दाब राखा; जर नाल्यातील पाणी असेल तर मास्क व वाळू गाळणी बसवा (साफ वाफसा पाणी असेल तर फक्त मास्क गाळणीही चालेल).
- **प्रणाली स्वच्छता:** दर ८ दिवसांनी वाळू गाळणी, मास्क गाळणी स्वच्छ करा; दर १०–१५ दिवसांनी आवश्यकतेनुसार आम्ल उपचार व क्लोरीन उपचार करा जेणेकरून कार्बोनेट/लोह थेंब काढले जातील आणि सूक्ष्मजीवांची वाढ थांबेल.

या पद्धतीने खरे सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये कोणती व किती मात्रेत द्यावीत हे तुमच्या पिकाची गरज आणि माती परीक्षणानुसार ठरवले जाते; त्यामुळे कोणत्या पीक प्रकारासाठी ही तंत्रे लागू करावयाची आहेत ते सांगितलेस तर आणखी नेमके मार्गदर्शन देईल.

**स्रोत: Krushi VNMAU** 

तुम्ही ठिबक सिंचन कोणत्या पिकाला (उदा. फळबाग, भाजीपाला) लावतो?

answer:
फवारणी करताना सुरक्षित राहण्यासाठी काही गोष्टी नेहमी पाळाव्यात, तसेच काही खबरदारी केल्यास धोका कमी होतो.

**फवारणी करताना (सुरक्षा):**
- वापरण्यापूर्वी कीटकनाशकाच्या लेबल व सूचना नीट वाचा आणि त्यांचे पालन करा.
- संरक्षक कपडे, बूट, हातमोजे, नाकमास्क/मेस्क अशी वैयक्तिक संरक्षण साधने (पी.पी.ई.) नेहमी घालून ठेवा.
- फवारणी करतांना खाणे, पिणे किंवा तंबाखू धूम्रपान करू नका.
- वारा वेगाप्रमाणे फवारणी करा; जेथे शक्य असेल तेथे सकाळी किंवा संध्याकाळी फवारणी करा.
- फवारणी दरम्यान बाजूला जेवण किंवा पाणी राखू नका; फवारणी सोल्यूशन बनवण्याच्या जागी ती पिकाची काढणी झाल्याशिवाय जपा.

**फवारणी झाल्यानंतर:**
- हात, पाय, चेहरा ही साबणावरुन चांगली धुवा.
- कपडे, यंत्राचे भाग इ. यांची स्वच्छता करा.
- जर शरीरावर स्पर्ष झाल्यास लगेच शरीर पाण्याने धुऊन घ्या.

**इतर खबरदारी:**
- कीटकनाशके बंद बॉक्समध्ये, लहान मुलांपासून दूर ठेवा.
- शेतामध्ये फवारणी झालेल्या जागी काळजी चिन्हाचा बोर्ड लावा आणि काही काळ थेट प्रवेश मर्यादित ठेवा.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ** व **क्रुषी दर्शनी (बि.एस्.के.के.व्ही., दापोली), ए.आय.सी.ए.आर. वार्षिक अहवाल २०२३-२४**

question: रोटाव्हेटर भाड्याने घेण्यासाठी माझ्या शेताच्या सर्वात जवळची सोय कोठे आहे?

आपल्या जवळा (दे), लोहा, नांदेड येथील सर्वात जवळची कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर सोय खाली आहे:

**कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर – बेत संगवि, लोहा**
पत्ता: माझा नांदेड शेतकरी प्रॉड्यूसर कंपनी लिमिटेड.
संपर्क व्यक्ती: विनोद दात्रीराम पांचाल
फोन: ७६२०५३९७०१
अंतर: ३ कि.मी.

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती**

रोटाव्हेटरच्या उपलब्धतेसाठी आणि भाड्याच्या रकमेसाठी याच क्रमांकावर आधी एक वेळ फोन करून खात्री करावी का?

question: वासरांना पहिली लस कधी द्यावी?
answer:
वासरांना पहिली लस साधारणपणे तीन महिन्यांच्या वयात द्यावी.

**लसीकरण वेळापत्रक:**
- खुर व तोंड रोग (फूट अँड माऊथ डिसीज/एफएमडी): ३ महिन्यांनंतर पहिली लस
- काळपुळी रोग (ब्लॅक क्वार्टर), हेंमरेजिक सीप्टिसीमिया आणि अँथ्रॅक्स: ६ महिन्यांनंतर पहिली लस
- ब्रुसेला लस: फक्त वासरू मुलींसाठी, ४ ते ८ महिन्यांच्या वयात एकाच वेळी

लसीकरणाची नेमकी मात्रा, कोणती कंपनीची लस घ्यावी आणि पुढच्या डोस्चे वेळापत्रक हे वापरलेल्या लसीनुसार बदलते, म्हणून जवळच्या पशुवैद्याचा सल्ला नक्की घ्या.

**स्रोत: मॅन्युअल ऑन मॅनेजमेंट गौशाला**  
तुमच्या गावाजवळील पशुवैद्यक किंवा पशुसंवर्धन कार्यालयाने नेमके कोणत्या आजारांसाठी लस दिली जाते हेही विचाराल?

question: नाशिकमधील कळवण तालुक्यात 'महाओनियन'ची साठवणूक केंद्रे आहेत का?

**महाओनियन (कांदे) साठी लागणारे गोदाम:**

- **लासालगाव महाओनियन व्हर्‍हेऊस**
पत्ता: कोटामगाव रोड, कांद्याच्या बाजाराजवळ, लासालगाव, निफाड, नाशिक
फोन: ०२५५०-२६६५७८
अंतर: ३१ किमी

- **मुसळगाव महाओनियन व्हर्‍हेऊस**
पत्ता: सर्व्हे नं. १४२/२, मुसळगाव मिडीसी क्षेत्र, सिन्नर, नाशिक
फोन: ९४२१८८७४४२
अंतर: २३ किमी

- **सिन्नर महाओनियन व्हर्‍हेऊस**
पत्ता: ए मालेगाव, सिन्नर, सिन्नर, नाशिक
फोन: ०२५५१-२३०२८७
अंतर: ३० किमी

**कोपरगाव महाओनियन व्हर्‍हेऊस** (ज्वारीसाठी सुद्धा वापरता येते):
पत्ता: कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, मार्केट यार्ड, कोपरगाव, आहमदनगर
फोन: ०२४२३-२२२३९५
अंतर: २२ किमी

**सांगणे महाओनियन व्हर्‍हेऊस**:
पत्ता: कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, मार्केट यार्ड, सांगणे, आहमदनगर
फोन: ०२४२५-२२६९९८
अंतर: ३२ किमी

या गोदामांमध्ये सुरक्षित आणि चांगले साठवणूक व्यवस्थापन आहे. कांद्याची साठवणूक करण्यापूर्वी फोन करून जागा आणि दर याबद्दल खात्री करावी.

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती**

तुम्हाला कांद्याच्या साठवणुकीसाठी कीटक नियंत्रण आणि तापमान व्यवस्थापनाचे सल्ला हवा आहे का?

question: माझं अनुदान मंजूर झालं आहे का? झालं असल्यास, ते माझ्या खात्यात कधी येईल?
answer:
तुमच्या महाडीबीटीवर तीन अर्ज दिसत आहेत आणि सध्या त्यापैकी कोणताही पूर्ण मंजूर व हप्ता जास्तीचे वितरण झालेल्या स्थितीत नाही.

- **इतर एक अर्ज (Unknown Scheme):**

  आर्थिक वर्ष: २०२५-२६  

बिल/चालान अपलोड करा ही स्थिती असल्यामुळे तुम्ही संबंधित बिल/चालान उपलब्ध करून दिले की पुढील प्रक्रिया जलद होईल. प्रतीक्षा यादीत असलेला घटक हा फक्त शिफारस/होर्डिंग/मंजुरीसाठी राखीव स्थितीत असू शकतो, म्हणून वितरणाचा निश्चित दिनांक सध्या उपलब्ध नाही. 

जर तुम्हाला बिल/चालान अपलोड केला असेल तर तो चालू अर्जाशी जोडलेला आहे का हे देखील तपासा.

question: प्रति हेक्टरी किती झिंक सल्फेट वापरावे?
answer:
प्रति हेक्टरी झिंक सल्फेटची मात्रा पीक व मातीनुसार बदलते, आणि खालील प्रमाणे दिली आहे.

**मात्रा (मातीतून):**
- गहू पिकासाठी: प्रति हेक्टर २० किग्रा झिंक सल्फेट शेणखतात मिसळून पेरणीच्या आधी सुमारे एक आठवड्याने देणे शिफारस केलेले आहे.
- भुईमुग पिकासाठी: प्रति हेक्टर १० किग्रा झिंक सल्फेट दर वर्षी रासायनिक खतांसोबत एकदा वापरण्याचे सांगितले आहे.
- टोमॅटो/फुल कोबी (अध्ययनातील) : फुल कोबीसाठी जमीनीतून झिंक सल्फेटचे प्रमाण प्रति हेक्टर ५ ते १५ किग्रा असे विविध प्रयोगांमध्ये दिले आहे; फवारणी स्वरूपात झिंक सल्फेटचे ०.२५% द्रावण देखील ठराविक अंतराने फवारण्यात येते.

**मात्रा (पानांवर फवारणी):**
- झिंक सल्फेटचे ०.५% ते १.०% द्रावण पानांवर फवारणी करून झिंक कमतरतेवर उपाय करण्याचे सूचक शब्द उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांमध्ये आहेत.

**वेळ:**
- गहू पिकासाठी पेरणीपूर्वी (एक आठवडा) झाडांत मिसळून, त्यानंतर फुटवे अवस्था आणि फुलोऱ्याच्या अवस्थेत झिंक ईडीटीएचे ०.२% द्रावण फवारणीचा उल्लेख असल्याचे नमूद आहे.

**स्रोत: एमपीकेव्ही कृषी दर्शन**, **डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ**, **कृषी व्हिएनएमएयू**; **आयसीएआर वार्षिक अहवाल २०२३-२४**

तुम्ही कोणत्या पिकासाठी झिंक सल्फेट वापरायचा आहे (उदा. गहू, भुईमुग, भाजीपाला)?

question: माझ्या तालुक्यात ब्रश कटर देणारे सेवा केंद्र कोणते आहे?

मालेगाव तालुक्यात खालील कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (सेवा केंद्र) आहेत जिथे ब्रश कटरसारखी शेती यंत्रसामग्री भाड्याने मिळू शकते:

संपर्क व्यक्ती: राहुल सुभाष लंडकर
अंतर: २ किमी

संपर्क व्यक्ती: आशिष श्यामसुंदर मुंडहडा
अंतर: ७ किमी

**मुंगसाजी महाराज स्वयं साहायता बचत गट**, उडी, मालेगाव
पत्ता: मुंगसाजी महाराज स्वयं साहायता बचत गट, उडी, मालेगाव, वाशिम

question: सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे?
answer:
सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प** अंतर्गत **सेंद्रिय उत्पादन युनिट** (जैविक खत युनिट) ही राज्य योजना उपलब्ध आहे.

**पात्रता:**
- ही योजना केवळ नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पातील गाव क्लस्टर्समध्ये समाविष्ट असलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांसाठी उपलब्ध आहे.
- या योजनेसाठी तुम्ही आधी दुसऱ्या योजनेमधून लाभ घेतला नसावा.
- युनिट स्थापनेनंतर, त्याच्या योग्य चालणीसाठी किमान दोन मोठी जनावरे (गाय, म्हशी, बोकडे) उपलब्ध असावीत.
- मर्यादा: जास्तीत जास्त पाच हेक्टरपर्यंत जमीनधारकांना फायदा मिळतो.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पाची डायरेक्ट बेनेफिट ट्रान्सफर प्रणाली वापरून शेतकरी आयडीने अर्ज करता येतो आणि आधार लिंक केलेल्या खात्यात वितरण होते.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्या बोर्डी गावाला नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पातील (पोक्रा) क्लस्टरमध्ये मान्यता आहे का ते तपासण्यासाठी स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी/प्रकल्प कार्यालयाचा संपर्क करू का?
