question: हरभरा पेरणीची योग्य वेळ कोणती आहे?
answer:
हरभऱ्याची योग्य पेरणी काळ महाराष्ट्रातील बदलत्या पाऊस परिस्थितीत साधारणपणे **१७ ते २३ सप्टेंबर** हा आहे, विशेषतः मध्यम ते खोल जमीन असलेल्या व पावसाच्या कमतरतेच्या भागात.

**पेरणी:**
- शिफारस केलेला कालावधी: **१७ ते २३ सप्टेंबर** (कृषी हवामान आठवडा क्रमांक ३८)
- या आठवड्यात पाऊस पडल्यास रब्बी पिकांची पेरणी करावी अशी शिफारस आहे.
- पेरणी शेवटच्या सप्टेंबरपर्यंत पूर्ण करावी जेणेकरून क्षेत्र तयार राहील.

**शेत तयारी:**
- खरीप पीक काढणी झाल्यानंतर खोल नांगरणी व दोन कुळवाण्या कराव्यात.
- जर खरीपात शेणखत टाकले नसेल तर चांगले कुजलेले शेणखत ५ टन प्रति हेक्टर मातीमध्ये मिसळावे.

आपल्या छ. संभाजीनगर–सिल्लोड परिसरात सध्याचा पाऊस पॅटर्न पाहून पेरणी लगेच करायची की थोडी थांबून करायची, असा सल्ला हवा आहे का?

question: पपईमध्ये आच्छादन (Mulching) करण्याचे फायदे काय आहेत?
answer:
पपईमध्ये आच्छादन केल्याने मातीचा ओलावा कायम राहतो, तण नियंत्रण होते आणि हंगामानुसार नवीन आच्छादन पिके घेतल्यास जिवंत आच्छादन मिळते.

**आच्छादनाचे मुख्य फायदे:**
- पपईच्या दोन्ही सऱ्यांतील दोन्ही बाजूंनी आच्छादन करू शकता.
- आंतरपीकांची मदत तण नियंत्रणासाठी होतो; तण उपटून त्याच जागी सोडावे, मग ते कोरडे आच्छादन म्हणून काम करते.
- आंतरपीकांचा कालावधी संपल्यावर कोरडी पाने व झाडे ही कोरडे आच्छादन बनतात.
- हंगामानुसार नवीन आंतरपीके घेतल्यास जिवंत आच्छादन मिळते.
- पपई व इतर बागायतिकांमध्ये आच्छादन पद्धत मातीचा ओलावा साठवण्यास मदत करते आणि पीक वाढ व फळधारण हाच अनुकूल ठरते असे दस्तऐवजात म्हटले आहे.

**कशी करावी (थोडक्यात):**
- आपली पपई लागवड कोणत्या पद्धतीने आहे (पाणी देण्याची) आणि सऱ्यांच्या बाजूने कोणते आंतरपीक घ्याल हे सांगा, म्हणजे त्यानुसार आच्छादनाची अधिक स्पष्ट सूचना देऊ शकतो?

**स्रोत: नेचरल फार्मिंग ट्रेनिंग टूलकिट & बेस्ट प्रॅक्टिसेस गाईड**

**चराई व सुरुंग व्यवस्था:** पावसाळ्यात रोज ३ ते ४ किग्रा हिरवा चारा, १ ते २ किग्रा कोरडा चारा आणि २५० ते ३५० ग्रॅम अन्नधान्य मिश्रण इतकाच दररोज खर्च ठरतो; त्यामुळे शेळीचे कुटुंब लहान असल्यास ३ ते ५ मीटर दोरीने बंद चराई करा आणि बाकी कामे सुरू ठेवावीत. पावसाळ्यात शेळी दिवसा निघत नाही असे झाले तर अस्थायी सावलीच्या आळ्यांत खाऊ-पिणीची तळी ठेवावीत.

**घरेलू हायड्रोपोनिक्स हिरवा चारा:** शुद्ध धान्य (अंकुरण ८०% पेक्षा जास्त) वाहाळून १२ ते २४ तास भिजवून थेंबदार पाण्याने फॉगर/तुषार सिंचन करून प्रत्येक २ तासांनी २ मिनिटे फवारणी द्या; एका ३×२ फूट ट्रेसाठी २ किग्रा धान्य लागते आणि ट्रेला प्रतिदिन २५० ते ३०० मि.ली. पाणी देणे पुरेसे असते. हा चारा पूर्ण वर्षभर, कमी जागा-पाणी-वेळेखर्चात होतो, माती लागत नाही आणि कीड-रोगांचे प्रमाण कमी राहते.

**भाजीपाला/फळांचे काडबा वापरणे:** भाजीपाला व फळांच्या शेतीमध्ये अवैद्य, उपलब्ध व स्वस्त भाजी-फळ काडब्यातील काही भाग जनावरांना दिल्यास उत्पादन खर्च कमी करता येतो; मात्र उच्च ओलावा असल्याने योग्य प्रकारे दाखवून/प्रक्रिया करून सुरक्षित मर्यादेतच समाविष्ट करा.

The PVC hydroponic structure (size 3 x 2 x 3 m) developed using PVC pipes can be used for green fodder [हिरवा चारा] production [उत्पादन]. **PDKV Kaushalya Vermicompost Unit [गांडूळखत युनिट]:** It is recommended to use the low-cost PDKV Kaushalya vermicompost unit [गांडूळखत युनिट] for vermicompost production [कृमिसंधारण खत उत्पादन]. **Features:** ``` ---- **MPKV Research Recommendation 2023 Rahuri** ``` 27. Forage [चारा] cactus can be utilized as forage [चारा] for goat [शेळी] by chopping during forage [चारा] scarcity period. 28. Value addition [मूल्यवर्धन] of cow dung [शेण] by vermicomposting [गांडूळ खत] is recommended to increase the profitability [फायदेशीरता] in dairy farming [दुग्धव्यवसाय]. 29. Low cost hard moorum bed without any construction is recommended for better quality and quantity vermicompost production [कृमिसंधारण खत उत्पादन] in a short period. 30. It is recommended to use betel vine leaves extract (10 g leaves + 100 ML water) @ 5% and sugar @ 28% of khoa for preparation of burfi having 6 days shelf life [टिकाऊपणा] at 30ºC. 31. For preparation of cheese spread it is recommended to use 6% guava [पेरू] fruit pulp of Sardar variety in the blend of cheddar cheese and goat [शेळी] milk [दूध] chakka in the proportion 40:60. ### Basic Sciences, Food Science and Biotechnology [जैवतंत्रज्ञान] 32. Use of 700 g Little millet [सावा] flour and 300 g Maida [मैदा] or 900 g Little millet [सावा] flour and 100 g Wheat [गहू] flour, 500 g sugar, 500 g vegetable fat, 5 g ammonium bicarbonate and 5 g sodium bicarbonate is recommended to prepare good quality nutritious biscuits with high fiber content upto 3 months storage [साठवण]. 33. Use of Dragon fruit [ड्रैगन फ्रूट] pulp 1000 g, sugar 1000 g, vegetable fat 25 g, skim milk [स्किम्ड दूध] powder 50 g, starch 60 g, salt [मीठ] 20 g and maltodextrin 20 g is recommended to prepare good quality and nutritious toffee upto 3 months storage [साठवण]. 34. It is recommended to prepare dry [कोरडे] safflower [करडई] leafy vegetable [पालेभाज्या] with good nutritional quality, organoleptic properties and good keeping quality up to 3 months by harvesting [कापणी] leaves at 30 days (DAS) with blanching at 60° C for 30 seconds in chemical solution of KMS (0.02%), MgO (1.5 g), Citric acid [सिट्रिक ऍसिड] (1%), NaHCO₃ (1.5%) and NaCl (1.5%) and drying [वाळवणे] in tray dryer at 55°C for 8 h. ``` ---- **STANDARD VETERINARY TREATMENT GUIDELINES FOR LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY** ``` *\*Disclaimer\** *The document on 'Standard Veterinary Treatment [उपचार] Guidelines for Livestock [पशुधन] and Poultry [कुक्कुट]' has been developed by the Department of Animal Husbandry [पशुसंवर्धन] and Dairying (DAHD), Government of India with support from the Food and Agriculture [शेती] Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the United States Agency for International Development (USAID).* *It is based on extant literature on the subject and inputs from senior veterinary professionals. These are merely advocacy guidelines for use of veterinary professionals, paraprofessionals, and animal health [पशु आरोग्य] workers in India, and should not be interpreted as 'legally binding' or mandatory 'regulation' to be followed by veterinary professionals. The final decision on the management [व्यवस्थापन] of disease [रोग] and sick animal including diagnosis [निदान], choice of drugs and their dose [मात्रा], duration of treatment [उपचार], and preventive measures rest on the professional experience and judgment of the attending veterinarians and the clinical status of the sick animals.* *While implementing the Standard Veterinary Treatment [उपचार] Guidelines (SVTG), all provisions of the Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984 (especially Section 30) must be strictly adhered to. These guidelines should be applied only under the supervision of a registered veterinary practitioner, as per the Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984, to prevent any misuse or misapplication of the guidelines.* *While all reasonable precautions have been taken to verify the information contained in this publication, the material is distributed without warranty of any kind, either expressed or implied. The responsibility for the interpretation [विश्लेषण] and use of the material lies with the reader. In no event shall DAHD, Ministry of Fisheries [मत्स्यव्यवसाय], Animal Husbandry [पशुसंवर्धन] and Dairying Government of India be liable for damages arising from its use.* ``` ---- **Animal Science and Technology Standard XII** ``` 4.2 Systems of goat [शेळी] rearing The goats are reared under different feeding [खाऊ घालणे] and management [व्यवस्थापन] systems according to size of flock and resources available. - 1. Tethering - 2. Extensive system [व्यापक प्रणाली] / Range system - 3. Semi intensive system [शून्य चराई] - 4. Intensive system [शून्य चराई] 1. Tethering : It is the method of grazing [चरणे]. It is followed only when 2-3 goats are maintained. In this method goat [शेळी] is tied to wooden peg with 3 to 5 m long rope [दोरी] for restricted grazing [चरणे]. Advantages [फायदे] - 1. Helps to keep the goats under controlled feeding [खाऊ घालणे] - 2. Utilization of grass is efficient - 3. Other plants can be protected from notorious behavior of goat [शेळी]. - 4. Goat [शेळी] keeper can carry out any other work while goat [शेळी] is grazing [चरणे]. 2. Extensive / Range systems : This system is commonly adopted in India. Goats are allowed to graze on pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] or free range, road sides. Small, marginal farmers and land less labourers take their goats and walk for long distance for feed and water. Advantages [फायदे] - 1. Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] cost is almost zero - 2. Useful in low resources, capital [भांडवल] and management [व्यवस्थापन] - 3. Most economical - 4. Goat [शेळी] fertilizes the grazing land [चराईची जमीन] by dropping manure [खत] and urine [मूत्र]. - 5. Tree lopping can be used as fodder [चारा]. Disadvantages - 1. Shrinkage of grazing land [चराईची जमीन] may not provide optimum nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] to goats - 2. The seasonal variations affect the quality and quantity of fodder [चारा] which may lead to malnutrition. - 3. The genetic potential [आनुवंशिक क्षमता] remains unexploited due to poor nutrition [पोषण]. ``` ---- **Animal Science and Technology Standard XII** ``` 1. Free range system This method is the oldest of all and has been used for centuries by general farmers, where there is no shortage of land. This system allows great but not unlimited, space to the birds on land where they can find an appreciable amount of food in the form of herbage, seeds and insects. At present due to advantages [फायदे] of intensive methods this system is almost outdated, but it plays important role in rural area. Advantages [फायदे] - 1. Less capital [भांडवल] investment [गुंतवणूक]. - 2. Minimum expenses on feed. - 3. Less labour is required. Disadvantages - 1. Low egg production [अंडे उत्पादन] and growth [वाढ]. - 2. More chances of infectious diseases including parasitic infestation. - 3. No protection from predatory animals and birds - 4. Sometimes birds lay eggs [अंडी] outside the area. - 5. Risk of theft of eggs [अंडी] and birds. - 6. More loss of energy in movement of birds. Backyard poultry [परसातील कुक्कुट पालन] farming [शेती करणे] - 1. Backyard poultry [परसातील कुक्कुट पालन] farming [शेती करणे] means rearing chicken in small numbers (10-20) by each household in the backyard under free range system. - 2. The birds are allowed for foraging provided with supplementary feeding [खाऊ घालणे] and clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी] during the day time, while at night they are provided with shelter [आश्रयस्थान], made of locally available low cost. - 3. Backyard poultry [परसातील कुक्कुट पालन] farming [शेती करणे] is an old age profession of rural India. - 4. It is having tremendous potential to increase poultry [कुक्कुट] production [उत्पादन] and can definitely contribute to poverty reduction. - 5. Backyard poultry [परसातील कुक्कुट पालन] can easily be started with improved backyard poultry [परसातील कुक्कुट पालन] breeds such as Giriraja, Grampriya and Swarnadhara. Remember... Chicks from improved backyard poultry [परसातील कुक्कुट पालन] breeds need brooding [वाढीसाठी ऊष्मा व काळजी देणे] and care during initial four weeks of age. After four weeks, they can be let free for scavenging in backyard. The night shelter [आश्रयस्थान] should have good ventilation [हवेची आदळ] and protection from predators and plenty of clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी] should be made available. The birds must be vaccinated against Mareks and Ranikhet disease [रोग]. There should be periodic deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] at 3-4 months interval. ``` ---- **Dairy Farming A Profitable Venture** ``` 6. Fodder conservation [चाऱ्याचे संवर्धन] and storage [साठवण]: A good progressive dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] farmer [शेतकरी] always plan for future because in India agriculture [शेती] is a gamble of monsoon [पावसाळा]. Any time in the year shortage of feed and fodder [खाद्य आणि चारा] can occur. In such scarcity period the cost crop [पीक] residues may sky rocket and dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] enterprise will be at loss. Green fodder [हिरवा चारा] resource are abundant during monsoon [पावसाळा] season. Excess green fodder [हिरवा चारा] should be conserved as hay or silage [मुरघास]. Tropical environment predominant all over India favour conservation as hay, but very few farmers have adopted this technique. Now a days silage [मुरघास] preparation has become popular and more number of dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] farmers are using this technology to supply green fodder [हिरवा चारा] during lean days of the year. Many farmers are burning the straws and stover [कडबा] in farm itself. Especially in Haryana and Punjab leading to environmental pollution. Such dry [कोरडे] crop [पीक] residues though nutritionally poor can be stored easily. These crop [पीक] residues can be enriched using techniques like urea [यूरिया] ammoniation, alkali treatment [उपचार] or adding molasses [मोलासेस]. Thus, by ensuring regular supply of quality forage [चारा] throughout the year is the most economical way for profitable and sustainability. 7. Unconventional / New feed resources: Several newer feed resource are identified and found useful for livestock [पशुधन] feeding [खाऊ घालणे]. Replacing part of the conventional feed resource is a wise way to bridge the deficit and can be solution reduce cost of production [उत्पादन]. Major factors which affect the use of unconventional feed resources are regional availability and suitability. Suitable processing [प्रक्रिया] / detoxification methods need to be adopted. And used at safe inclusion level in animals. Horticultural crop [पीक] residues are new feed resources which can be used as animal feed [जनावरांचे खाद्य]. India is the second largest producer of vegetables and fruits. Among theses about 33% is wasted during harvesting [कापणी], marketing and processing [प्रक्रिया]. Most of these feeds are nutritious with less of ANFs and available at cheaper rate. Major problem in using theses feed resources are they are having high moisture cntent. But they can be utilized efficiently after proper processing [प्रक्रिया]. ```

question: पिक विमा योजनांचा अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?
answer:
पिक विमा योजनांमध्ये **प्रधानमंत्री पिक विमा योजना** हे केंद्र शासनाचे मुख्य विमा प्रकल्प आहे, जे नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड-रोग यांच्यामुळे पिकांचा हानी झाल्यावर आर्थिक मदत करते; तुमच्यासाठी अर्ज दिलेल्या मुदतीत ऑनलाइन करायचा असतो.

**विम्यातील मुख्य बाबी:**
- ही योजना सूचित (विज्ञप्ती केलेल्या) जिल्हा/तालाठ्या/गावातील सूचित पिकांसाठी लागू असते.
- अनुदानार्थी व गैर-अनुदानार्थी दोघांनाही निवडायची परवानगी आहे (परंतु कोणते पीक आणि क्षेत्र सध्या सूचीबद्ध आहेत ते स्थानिक अधिकाऱ्यांकडून खात्री करा).
- किमान धोरित पातळी साधारणपणे ७०% ठरवली जाते आणि क्षतिपूर्ती पिककापणी नोंदीच्या सरासरी उत्पन्नावर आधारित असते.
- तुमचे एकूण विमा मूल्य प्रति हेक्टर संबंधित पिकाच्या खर्चमानानुसार ठरते.

**पात्रता:**
- सूचित क्षेत्रात सूचित पीक घेणाऱ्या शेतकरी पात्र आहेत.
- हातपायांनी नोंदणीकरण/भागाशी संबंधित नोंदीनुसार शेती करता येणारे (संबंधित प्रमाणपत्रे आवश्यक आहेत).

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- आय.एग्रिस्टॅक क्रमांक
- आधार कार्ड
- बँक खाते तपशील
- जमीन व पीक तपशील
- डिजिटल पीक सर्वेक्षण (ई पिक्क पाहणी)

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- दिलेल्या वेळेत www.pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा (शिलक तारीख स्थानिक अधिकाऱ्याकडून/सूचनांनुसार तपासा).

**टॅपक विमा:**
कोणतीही पिकांची सूची किंवा तुमच्या गावातील कोणत्या पिकांसाठी अर्ज स्वीकारले जातात याची माहिती सध्या उपलब्ध न दिसली; त्यामुळे वाशिम्‍यातील तुमच्या तालुका कृषी अधिकारी यांच्याकडे तुमच्या गावासाठी सूचीबद्ध पिकांची माहिती लगेच तपासून घ्या.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुमच्या ५५ अंशांमध्ये या वर्षी कोणते मुख्य पीक घेणार आहात?

question: काल दुपारी सुटलेल्या वाऱ्यामुळे संत्रा बागेत फळगळ झाली असेल का?
answer:
काल (१५ मार्च) आपल्या गावाजवळील नोंदणीत वाऱ्याचा कमाल वेग ६.२ किमी/तास होता आणि पाऊस ० मिमी होता; अशी जोरदार वारं कमी दिसते. त्यामुळे फक्त वारे या कारणासाठी मोठ्या प्रमाणावर फळगळ झाली आहे याचे निश्चित म्हणणे देता येत नाही.

**फळगळ रोखण्याचे शिफारसी:**
- उन्हाळ्यात मातीची ओलावा राखा — बागेच्या प्लॉट/मडबंड आशेपासून जमीन ५ सेंटीमीटर जाडीचा गवत आच्छादनाने घडा, यामुळे फळगळ कमी होते.
- बाहर व्यवस्थापनानुसार (म्होर बहार), फूलधारणेनंतर लगेच एथेफॉन ६०० पी.पी.एम. (६०० मिलीग्रॅम प्रति लिटर पाणी) या वाढ नियंत्रकाची विरळणी फवारणी करावी किंवा हाताने वाटाणा आकाराची फळे काढावीत.
- उन्हाळ्यात बागेत मुलचिंग (आच्छादन) केल्याने देखील फळगळ कमी होते.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; हवामान इतिहास (स्कायमेट)**

आता संत्री बागेतील फळे कोणत्या आकाराची आहेत — वाटाणा आकाराची की त्यापेक्षा मोठी?

These bundles of hay should be stored in moisture and dust free places like bunkers/godowns to maintain quality for longer period. Hay can be fed @ 5 kg per animal per day with or without chaffing.

question: पावसाच्या अंदाजामुळे खत देणे पुढे ढकलावे का?
answer:
आत्ता तुमच्या बोर्डी (मालेगाव, वाशिम) साठी पाऊस होण्याची शक्यता कमी दिसते.

पुढील ५ दिवसांचा हवामान अंदाज:
- मंगळवार व बुधवार : पाऊस नाही
- गुरुवार : १ मिमी पाऊस पडण्याची शक्यता
- शुक्रवार : ४ मिमी पाऊस पडण्याची शक्यता
- शनिवार : २ मिमी पाऊस पडण्याची शक्यता

question: मी सोयाबीन आणि कापूस दोन्ही पिकतो, कोणत्या योजनेत अर्ज करणे फायदेशीर आहे?
answer:
आपल्या गावात सोयाबीन आणि कापूस दोन्ही पिकवत असाल तर खालील योजना आपल्यासाठी फायदेशीर ठरू शकतात.

**बिरसा मुंडा कृषी क्रांती योजना (टी.एस.पी. व ओ.टी.एस.पी.)** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी अनुसूचित जमातीच्या शेतकऱ्यांना आंबेडकर सप्ताहानंतर अनेक घटकांचे अनुदान देते.

**पात्रता:**
- लाभार्थी अनुसूचित जमातीचे शेतकरी असावे लागतात.
- योग्य प्राधिकाराद्वारे कायदेशीर जातीचा प्रमाणपत्र आवश्यक आहे.
- ७/१२ उतारा व जमीनीचे क्षेत्रमर्यादा निकष पूर्ण पाळावे लागतात.
- आधारशी जोडलेले स्वतंत्र बँक खाते आवश्यक आहे.
- गरीब शेतकऱ्यांना प्राधान्य दिले जाईल.
- या योजनेतील नवीन बांधकाम घटक घेतला तर त्यानंतर पुढच्या चाळीस वर्षांमध्ये जुन्या बांधकाम दुरुस्तीचा लाभ मिळेल.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:** महाराष्ट्र शासनाच्या महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा; निवड प्रथम येणाऱ्याला प्रथम सेवा तत्वावर होते, तेव्हा अतिरिक्त कागदपत्रे सादर झाल्यानंतर अंदाजे चाळीस दिवसांच्या आत पूर्व मंजुरी मिळणे शक्य असते.

**प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (पी.एम.एफ.बी.वाई.)** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी सूचीबद्ध पिकांना नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड किंवा रोगामुळे होणाऱ्या फसल नुकसानासाठी विमा संरक्षण देते.

**पात्रता:**
- सूचीबद्ध क्षेत्रात सूचीबद्ध पीक घेणारे सर्व शेतकरी पात्र आहेत.
- कर्जदार व अनकर्जदार शेतकऱ्यांसाठी पर्यायी आहे.
- विमा मर्यादा नोडक्रीपेनुसार ठरते.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:** www.pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर निर्धारित वेळेत ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा.

**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी योजना (पी.एम.किसान)** ही केंद्र योजना आहे जी शेतकरी कुटुंबाला दरवर्षी **₹६०००** तीन समान हप्त्यांत प्रत्यक्ष मदत देते.

**पात्रता:**
- शेतीयोग्य जमीन धारक असणारी आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल शेतकरी कुटुंबे पात्र आहेत.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:** pmkisan.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा.

**राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा आणि पोषण अभियान (एन.एफ.एस.एन.एम.) व्यावसायिक पीक—कापूस विकास योजना** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी कापूस पिकासाठी एन.एफ.एस.एन.एम. अंतर्गत प्रमुख घटकांचा समावेश करते.

**पात्रता:**
- पीक दर्शन: समूह लाभार्थी आवश्यक आहे.
- बायोचॅर: वैयक्तिक लाभार्थी आवश्यक आहे.
- प्रशिक्षण: कृषी विभागाचे कर्मचारी आवश्यक आहेत.
- महाराष्ट्रात निवडक तेरा जिल्ह्यांमध्ये ही योजना राबवली जाते (यात नंदुरबार देखील आहे).

**अर्ज कसा करावा:** पीक दर्शन आणि बायोचॅरसाठी महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर अर्ज करता येतो; बीजन उत्पादनसाठी राजकीय अधिवेशनावरून अर्ज करता येतो.

**राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा मिशन—ऊतके (ओ.एल.एस.) तेलबिया** ही राज्य योजना आहे जी तेलबियांसाठी महत्त्वपूर्ण घटकांचा समावेश करते.

**पात्रता:**
- पीक दर्शन: शेतकऱ्यांचा समूह आवश्यक आहे.
- प्रमाणित बीज वितरण: वैयक्तिक शेतकरी आवश्यक आहे.
- पीक नंतर तंत्रज्ञान आणि गोदाम: समूह आवश्यक आहे.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:** पीक दर्शन व प्रमाणित बीज वितरणसाठी महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवरून निवड होते; पीक नंतर तंत्रज्ञान व गोदामसाठी डी.ओ.एस.एम. द्वारे अर्ज होता येतो.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

कोणत्या विशिष्ट घटकावर (उदा. सिंचन सुविधा, कापूस पिकासाठी विशेष घटक, किंवा विमा) अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
64

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-bmkky

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Birsa Munda Krushi Kranti Yojna (TSP and OTSP)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Tribes (ST) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden
12. Drilling well/ Borewell

*Introduction*:
Tribal Sub-Plan (In-Area and Outside-Area) is being implemented since 1992-93 to increase the income of Scheduled Tribe farmers and improve their standard of living. Considering the needs of the farmers in the changed situation, as per the Government administrative approval Ref/letter No. Auyo 2416/Pr.No.177/4A, dated 9/8/2017. to revise the said scheme from the year 2017-18 vide Government Decision Also, the Government has decided to implement the said scheme under the name Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Inside-Area and Outside-Area).
Also, the Government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the Government decision dated 01 October, 2024.

*Benefits*:
The said scheme should be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 & components admmissible for subsidy are as follows.
 1. In the said scheme, the grant will be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
 1.1 For New Irrigation Well Maximum subsidy Limit is Rs. 4,00,000/- is admissible as subsidy
 1.2 For Old Well Repair Maximum subsidy Limit is Rs. 1,00,000/- is admissible as subsidy 1.3 For Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds Maximum subsidy Limit is Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy
 1.4 For Inwell Boring Maximum subsidy Limit is 40,000/- is admossible as subsidy
 1.5 For Electricity Connection Maximum subsidy Limit is Amount Rs. 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.6 For Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)Maximum subsidy Limit is For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.7For Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)Maximum subsidy Limit is subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.8 For HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item) Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy . 1.9.1 Under Micro irrigation system for Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Per Drop Plus Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 10% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana and (2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 15% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less is admissible as subsidy.
 1.9.2 Under Micro irrigation system for Drip Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Per Drop Plus Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 10% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana and (2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 15% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. 10.For Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Ammount Rs.50,000/- is admossible as subsidy 11.For Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) Maximum subsidy Limit is 5,000/- is admossible as subsidy 12. For Drilling well/ Borewell (new item) Maximum subsidy Limit is Grant of Rs. 50,000/- or actual cost, whichever is less is admossible as subsidy.

*Eligibility*:
Beneficiary eligibility criteria:-
1.The beneficiary must be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Tribe category.
2.The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.The farmer must have a 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in his name.
 (Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika areas (Ref. Govt.t Letter No. Sankirna-2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dt. 24.4. 2018))
4.The beneficiaries must have their own bank account and the said bank  account must be linked to the Aadhaar card.
5.The beneficiary below the poverty line will be given first priority.6.The condition of Rs. 1,50,000/- annual income limit applicable to the beneficiaries of the said scheme is being abolished. The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the land of the tribal beneficiaries is in remote and fragmented areas, two or more beneficiaries with land holdings less than 0.40 hectares come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be allowed to benefit from the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of holding area will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
6.The priority order of beneficiary selection will be as follows.
6.1 Beneficiaries below the poverty line,
6.2 Tribal beneficiarie,
6. 3. Individual Forest leaseholders
6..4 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be admissible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years
6.3 If the benefit has been given from the tribal scheme for similar agricultural development schemes as well as from the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit given under this scheme will not be admissible.
6.4 A note will be made in the 7/12th statement of the beneficiaries who have taken the benefit of the said scheme.
District Selection Committee: -   The following committee will be constituted to finalize the selection of beneficiaries at the district level under Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Inside-sub plan Area and Outside sub plan Area) Scheme.
        Additional Chief Executive Officer, Z.P.                                                    - Chairman
        District Superintendent Agriculture Officer                                            - Member
        Executive Engineer, Minor Irrigation, Z.P.                                               - Member
        District Level Officer of Ground Water Survey System                         - Member
        Assistant Commissioner, Social Welfare                                                 - Member
        Special District Social Welfare Officer (Zilla Parishad)                          - Member
        Agricultural Development Officer, Z.P.                                                    -Member Secretary
For this scheme, applications from farmers will be invited on the Maha-DBT portal at mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ farmer/ login/ login and the applications received within the limit of the target received by the concerned talukas will be selected online on a first come, first served basis. For this, the target received district-wise will be entered on the portal at the Agriculture Commissionerate level. *Introduction*:
National Mission on Oilseed and Oil Palm (NMOOP) was launched by Government of India in year 2014-15. In 2018-19 GoI has merged NMOOP with NFSM as NFSM (OS&OP).  Afterwards, from the year 2022-23, NFSM (OS & OP) subsumed as National Mission On Edible Oil (NMEO) and till 2024-25, the following three missions were under this mission. 1) Mission No. 1: Oilseeds Crops 2) Mission No. 3: Tree Oilseeds Crops 3) TRFA (Oilseeds).
         The Central Government has approved a new Mission called National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds for the years 2024-25 to 2030-31. This has been done to promote the production of oilseed crops with primary focus on mustard, groundnut and soybean and to focus on secondary oilseeds and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO) along with other oilseed crops. Secondary Vegetable Oil Sub-mission is also part of the National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds (NMEO-OS) mission and has been included in it, which mainly includes oil extraction from secondary sources like cottonseed, rice bran and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO). Under this mission, 27 districts of Maharashtra have been selected for soybean, groundnut, safflower, mustard, Niger, sunflower and sesame. The mission will be implemented through Value Chain Cluster (VCC) and for this, a farmer producer company/cooperative/public or private organization will be selected as the Value Chain Partner (VCP) for each cluster. At the district level, the Value Chain Partners (VCPs) will be selected by the District Executive Committee (DEC).
        While implementing the components under the scheme in the year 2025-26, while selecting beneficiaries, the following category wise allocation should be made: General 74.80%, Scheduled Castes 16.60%, Scheduled Tribes 8.60%. 4. Availability of improved seeds: Elimination of deficiencies in seed production and distribution systems to ensure availability of quality seeds.
5. Linkage to marketing system: Linking oilseed farmers and Value Chain Partners (VCPs) to marketing system and processing industries.
6. Support for oil production and collection from secondary oilseeds: Increasing production of secondary oilseeds and tree-borne oilseeds (TBOs) in particular.

question: What is the best way to disinfect the floor of the cattle shed after yesterday's rain?
answer:
पावसानंतर गोठ्याच्या माळ्यास जास्त साफसाफ करून नंतरच कोरडेपणाने जंतूनाशक (डिझइन्फेक्टंट) फवारणी करावी, कारण सेंद्रिय पदार्थामुळे जंतूनाशकाची कार्यक्षमता कमी होते.

**माती:** पावसानंतर माळी ओलसर व चिकट असल्याने सर्व शेण, मूत्र, उरलेले चारा आणि कचरा पूर्णपणे बाहेर काढा; माळी, पिण्याचे तळे, खुरटी ही घटक ब्रश आणि भुर्ज्याने छोट्या भागात चांगले धुवा, त्यानंतर स्वच्छ पाण्याने पुन्हा धुवा.

**कोरडेपण:** गोठा हवे देऊन वाऱ्याचा वापर करा किंवा थेट सूर्यप्रकाश गोठ्यात येईल असे दिलासे ठेवा, कारण सूर्यप्रकाश हे नैसर्गिकरीत्या सुरक्षित आणि प्रभावी जंतूनाशक आहे.

**फवारणी:** माळी व इतर पृष्ठभाग पूर्ण कोरडे झाल्यानंतर बोरिक ॲसिड, क्वार्टनरी अमोनियम संयुग, ब्लिच (सोडियम हायपोक्लोराइट), पोटॅशियम परॉक्सी-मोनोसल्फेट, क्लोरेक्सिडीन किंवा फिनॉलिक जंतूनाशके यांपैकी कुठलेही एक निवडा; हे फवारणीने किंवा रगडून लावता येतात.

**किमान नियोजन:** रोग उद्रेक नसल्यास रोजील धुणे, सकाळ-संध्याकाळी सूर्यप्रकाश, आणि कालांतराने पांढरा वाफसा यामुळे गोठा मध्यम प्रमाणात निर्जंतुक राहण्यास पुरेसे आहे.

**रोग उद्रेक असल्यास:** सर्व माळी, दीड मीटर उंचीपर्यंतची भिंत, पिण्याच्या तळ्यांचे आतील भाग, खुरटी आणि प्राण्यांना स्पर्श होणारी उपकरणे — सर्व धुवून नंतर वरील प्रमाणात जंतूनाशक लावा.

Disinfection

It means destroying the cause of infection [संसर्ग]. Since the causative agents of many diseases are extremely small and may remain indefinitely in dust, cracks [भेगा] and crevices of buildings, disinfection must be carried out carefully to eradicate common enemies of life such as bacteria [जीवाणू], viruses, moulds and eggs [अंडी] of insects from contaminated premises. The nature of the surfaces will influence the efficacy of the disinfection. Rough, porous surfaces are harder to disinfect than smooth surfaces. Porous surfaces are also harder to clean than smooth surfaces. Porous surfaces will therefore have heavier soil [माती] loads after cleaning [साफसफाई], which further increase the difficulty of disinfection. A broad spectrum disinfectant with penetration enhancers should be used to disinfect *gaushalas.*

*Sunshine for disinfection:* Direct rays from the sun are one of the most effective germ killers while being entirely safe and inexpensive. The farm buildings should be so oriented as to take full advantage of this natural resource. the mornings and evenings. The dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] utensils should also be kept in the sun for drying [वाळवणे] and disinfection after cleaning [साफसफाई].

question: Bee ani khat ekatra perni yantrachi dekhbhal kashi karavi?
answer:
बी आणि खत एकत्र पेरणारे यंत्र (खत ड्रिल) टिकायला साधे नियम ठेवा जेणेकरून त्याची आयुष्य वाढेल.

**पेरणीनंतर:** बीच्या आणि खताच्या बॉक्समध्ये राहिलेली गोळा काढून टाका, काल्हावट/गोठलेली बाजू हलक्या माराने उकळवा. आतील बाजूस कोरडे फाशी/सुकवा लावून धूळ व माती चांगली घ्या. 

**संधारणासाठी सांभाळ:** लोखंडी भाग पातळ तेलाचा लेप द्या; स्फुरद/खताचा संपर्क होऊ नये म्हणून अडचण जाणवल्यास कापडाच्या तुकड्याने हाताने स्वच्छ करा. बॅरेल-शिल्ड किंवा प्लेट जुळलेली असले तर ती सुधारित ठेवा.

**साठवण:** यंत्र शेडमध्ये ऊर्जाविना उभे ठेवून, गिरीचे दाब तपासून ठेवा. पेरणीच्या अगदी आधीच यंत्राची तपासणी करावी.

**दुरुस्ती प्रशिक्षण उपलब्ध असल्यास:** कृषी यंत्रसामग्री दुरुस्ती-देखभाल यांचे चार आठवड्यांचे तंत्रज्ञ प्रशिक्षण उपलब्ध आहे; अशा प्रशिक्षणात यंत्राचा अधिक चांगला सांभाळ शिकवतात.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ**, **क्रुषी व्हीएनएमकेव्ही**; **सब-मिशन ऑन अ‍ॅग्रिक्लचरल मेकनायझेशन (एसएमएएम) मार्गदर्शक सूचना**

आपल्याकडे हे यंत्र भैसवंयी आहे की ट्रॅक्टरवर चालते?

question: माझ्या गव्हाच्या पिकासाठी सर्वात जवळचे सरकारी गोदाम दाखवा.
answer:
आपल्या बोर्डी गावापासून सर्वात जवळचे सरकारी गोदाम म्हणजे मालेगाव (वाशिम) येथे असलेले कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समितीचे गोदाम आहे.

**मालेगाव (वाशिम) गोदाम**
पत्ता: कृषी उत्पन्न बाजार समिती, विष्ठांग्रुहाच्या समोर, मालेगाव
फोन: ०७२५४-२७११०४
अंतर: ४.२ कि.मी.

गोदामाचा व्यवस्थापक यांशी संपर्क करून गहू साठवण्यासाठी जागा व हप्त्याबद्दल चौकशी करा; आपला ०.५५ हेक्टर क्षेत्र असल्याने आवश्यक ती रक्कम नोंदवून ठेवू शकता.

**स्रोत: कृषी सेवा माहिती**

गहू आत्ताच विक्री करायचा की काही महिने सुरक्षित ठेवायचा?

question: केळी बागेसाठी कोणत्या सरकारी योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो?
answer:
आपल्या गावात पोक्रा-निधीचा लाभ नाही; आपले गाव नाला, अक्कलकुवा (नंदुरबार) आणि आपली श्रेणी एस.टी., जमीन ०.६८ हेक्टर आहे, त्यामुळे एस.टी. शेतकऱ्यांना मिळणारी राज्य आणि केंद्र शासनाच्या फलोत्पादन/सिंचन योजनाच प्रभावी राहतील.

**बीरसा मुंडा कृषी क्रांती योजना (टी.एस.पी. व ओ.टी.एस.पी.)**: ही महाराष्ट्र राज्य योजना आहे जी नवीन विहीर साठी कमाल ₹४,००,००० पर्यंत सबसिडी देते; शेतीला लागणारे खालील घटक मिळू शकतात: जुनी विहीर दुरुस्ती कमाल ₹१,००,०००, शेततळे प्लास्टिक लायनिंग कमाल ₹२,००,०००, बोरवेल ड्रीलिंग घटकासाठी ₹५०,००० किंवा खर्चापैकी जे कमी ते, पी.डब्ल्यू.सी./एच.डी.पी. पाइपसाठी कमाल ₹५०,०००, ड्रिप सेट अनुदान घटकासाठी कमाल ₹९७,००० पर्यंत.  
**पात्रता:**
- बाeneficiary असणे आवश्यक आहे: एस.टी. शेतकरी असणे आणि जात प्रमाणपत्र हवे
- आपल्या नावावर ७/१२ व ८-अ उतारा असावा
- आधार-लिंकृत बँक खाते असावे
- आर्थिक मर्यादा कोणतीही नाही; महिला व दिव्यांग लाभार्थ्यांना प्राधान्य

**मिशन फॉर इंटिग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर (एम.आय.डी.एच.) — क्षेत्र विस्तार:** या केंद्र शासनाच्या योजनेत पिकांच्या भागात लागवड साठी अनुदान मिळते (किमान ०.२० हेक्टर जमीन हवी आणि लागवड पूर्णपणे नवीन असावी); या योजनेत केळीचा थेट उल्लेख दस्तऐवजात स्पष्टपणे उपलब्ध नाही, पण फळबाग लागवड प्रकारांमध्ये मदत उपलब्ध असते.

**मिशन फॉर इंटिग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर (एम.आय.डी.एच.) — पाण्याचे स्रोत निर्मिती:** आपल्या बागेतील पाणी टिकवण्यासाठी शेततळ्याच्या प्लास्टिक लायनिंगवर अनुदान मिळते (सरासरी ५०% अनुदान किंवा मर्यादेपैकी जे कमी ते), आणि आपणास एम.आय.डी.एच.द्वारे खालील मॉडेल्समधील अनुदान रक्कम मिळू शकते: १५×१५×३ मी मॉडेल साठी सबसिडी ₹२८,०००, २०×१५×३ मी साठी ₹३२,०००, २०×२०×३ मी साठी ₹४१,०००, २५×२०×३ मी साठी ₹५०,०००, २५×२५×३ मी साठी ₹५९,०००, ३०×२५×३ मी साठी ₹६८,०००, ३०×३०×३ मी साठी ₹७५,०००.  
**पात्रता:**
- लाभार्थ्याकडे फलोत्पादन पिक लागवड असावी

**अर्ज कसा करावा:** या सर्व योजनांसाठी महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवरून ऑनलाईन अर्ज करता येतो आणि आपल्या तालुक्यात निवड झाल्यानंतर अद्ययावत निकषानुसार प्रस्तावानुसार कार्यवाही होते.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्या बागेसाठी नेमके कोणते कार्य करायचे आहे — केळी लागवड, सिंचनासाठी शेततळे लायनिंग, की ड्रिप/स्प्रिंकलर?

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

3 months 3.GSDA Certificates

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: सीताफळावरील पिठ्या ढेकूण (Mealybugs) साठी जैविक नियंत्रण सुचवा.
answer:
सीताफळावरील पिठ्या ढेकूण जैविक पद्धतीने नियंत्रित करता येते, आणि उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांमध्ये खालील उपाय स्पष्टपणे सांगितले आहेत.

**जैविक कीटकनाशक फवारणी:**  
लिसेनिसिलियम लेसनी बुरशी (जैविक कीटकनाशक) चे ४० ग्रॅम १० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करा. या जैविक घटकाचा वापर द्राक्ष, सीताफळ, आंबा अशा पिकांवर रस शोषणाऱ्या किडींसाठी करायला सुचविला आहे.

**परभक्षी कीटक:**  
क्रिप्टोलेमस मोन्ट्रूझिएरी हे परभक्षी कीटक वापरा; हे प्रौढ व पिल्ल्यांचे नियंत्रण करण्यास मदत करते आणि एकात्मिक व्यवस्थापनांत समाविष्ट करावे असे दस्तऐवजात सांगितले आहे.

**नैसर्गिक शत्रू राखणी:**  
आवश्यक असल्यास पीठाच्या ढेकूणाचे नैसर्गिक शत्रू बागेत राखणे हेही एक सामान्य जैविक नियंत्रण तत्त्व आहे, ज्यामुळे किडीची संख्या जास्तीत जास्त कमी ठेवली जाऊ शकते.

**इतर महत्त्वाचे सूचना:**  
अत्यधिक प्रादुर्भावात झाडावर चिकट-प्रतिरोधक कीटकनाशकांची (रासायनिक) फवारणी टाळावी, कारण त्यामुळे जैविक घटकांची कार्यक्षमता कमी होऊ शकते असे मार्गदर्शन दिलेले आहे.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शन (एमपीकेव्ही), व्हीएनएमकेव्ही परभणी, कृषी दर्शन डॉ. बीएसकेकेव्ही दापोली २०२५**

तुम्हाला ही लिसेनिसिलियम लेसनी बुरशी कोणत्या नावाने/ब्रँडने स्थानिक शेती विज्ञान केंद्रात मिळते का ते माहिती हवी आहे का?

question: हिरवळीच्या खताचा वापर करून जमिनीचा पोत कसा सुधारावा?
answer:
हिरवळीच्या खतामुळे जमिनीला सेंद्रिय पदार्थ मिळतो, त्यामुळे मातीचा पोत सुधारतो व पाणी धारण क्षमता वाढते; म्हणून शेतीत सेंद्रिय खते वापरली की मातीचा पोत मऊ आणि भुसभुशीत होण्यास मदत होते.

**हिरवळीचे पीक कोणते:** शेंगायुक्त पिके जसे ढैंचा (सेसबिया), उडीद, मूग, चवळी, गवार, तसेच गिरिपुष्प, सुबाभळ, करंज यांची पाने-कोवळ्या काड्या मातीमध्ये बुडविल्या की हिरवळीचे खत तयार होते.
**कसे करावे:** हिरवळीचे पीक फुलोऱ्यावर आल्यावर जमिनीत नांगरून मिसळावे किंवा गिरिपुष्पाच्या पानांसारख्या पिकांचे हिरवे कच्‍चे सामाईक पदार्थ जमिनीमध्ये गुंडाळून साठवावे; यामुळे मातीचा पोत सुधारतो, पाणी धारण क्षमता वाढते आणि जमिनीतील सूक्ष्मजीवांची कार्यक्षमताही सुधारते.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; कृषी एन.एन.आर.एम.ए.यू., औरंगाबाद**

तुम्हाला कोणत्या पिकासाठी किंवा कुठल्या प्रकारच्या जमिनीसाठी हिरवळीची खते घालायची आहेत ते सांगाल का?

Organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] is a sustainable farming [शाश्वत शेती] method based on various elements of nature. question: सगण आंबा बागेचे व्यवस्थापन कसे करावे?
answer:
आंबा बागेच्या व्यवस्थापनासाठी मुख्य कामे म्हणजे फांद्या छाटणी, सेंद्रीय/रासायनिक खते देणे, ठिबक किंवा सूक्ष्म तुषारसिंचनाने पाण्याचे नियोजन करणे आणि आजार-कीड यांच्या प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाययोजना असे आहेत. तुम्ही सांगितला “सगण” हा शब्द उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांत सापडला नाही, पण आंब्यावर लागू असलेले व्यवस्थापनाचे तपशील खाली दिले आहेत.

**फांद्या छाटणी (पर्णछाया व्यवस्थापन):**
- पहिली छाटणी काढणीनंतर जून/जुलैपर्यंत पूर्ण करा; खालील लटकणाऱ्या फांद्या व भोवतालीतील गोंधळलेल्या फांद्या काढा; रुग्ण/कोरड्या फांद्या काढा आणि एका वेळी २५% पेक्षा जास्त बायोमास काढू नका, अन्यथा फूलधारणा कमी होऊ शकते.
- दुसरी छाटणी फुलोऱ्यानंतर डीसेंबरमध्ये सुरू करा व १२ आठवड्यांत पूर्ण करा; पुन्हा खालील लटकणाऱ्या फांद्या काढा.
- टिप छाटणी: नवीन शेंगा परिपक्व लाखापर्यंत वापस कापा ज्यामुळे फूलधारणा चालना मिळते.
- रसायन व्यवस्थापन (छाटणीनंतर): छाटणीने झाडांना तातडीने संरक्षण मिळावे, त्यासाठी छाटलेल्या भागावर बोर्डो पेस्ट लावा; नवीन पाने येत असताना बुरशीजन्य रोग किंवा पान खाणाऱ्या अळ्या आल्या तर लक्षणे ओळखून नियंत्रण घ्या.

**खत व्यवस्थापन:**
- सेंद्रीय अन्नद्रव्ये: घनजीवंमृत १०२० किलो प्रति झाड जून/जुलै आणि ऑक्टोबर/नोव्हेंबर दरम्यान झाडाच्या वयानुसार देणे शक्य आहे.
- जीवंमृत फवारणी: १५ वर्षांची बाग असल्यास प्रथम फवारणी डिसेंबर/जानुवारी (१५ लिटर जीवंमृत + २०० लिटर पाणी) आणि दुसरी फवारणी फेब्रुवारी/मार्च (३० लिटर जीवंमृत + २०० लिटर पाणी) अशी शिफारसीत वेळापत्रकाप्रमाणे करता येते.
- रासायनिक खते: खते केवळ एका माध्यमातून न देता रासायनिक व सेंद्रीय दोन्ही मार्गानी आधार पोषक द्या; खताची मात्रा, प्रकार आणि वेळ विद्यापीठ शिफारसीनुसार ठरवा (दस्तऐवजांत विशिष्ट मात्रा स्पष्ट दिलेली नाही).

**पाणी व्यवस्थापन:**
- ठिबक किंवा सूक्ष्म तुषारसिंचन पद्धतीने बागेला गरजेनुसार नियमित पाणी द्या; पावसाळ्यातही जर झाडांना पाण्याचा ताण दिसला तर सिंचन करा; तण नियमित काढा.
- बागेच्या कुंपणाभोवती उंच वारा रोधक झाडे लावल्यास उन्हाच्या जोरदार हवेपासून संरक्षण मिळते.

**अन्य:**
- कोरडे छाटणी टाळा; दरवर्षी शास्त्रीय छाटणी करा; छाटणीनंतर कायद्याच्या दृष्टीने योग्य औषधाची मात्रा/फवारणी विद्यापीठ/विश्वासू स्रोतानुसार करा.
- मल्चिंग: ऊस पेंढा, कोरडे गवत, तांदळाचा पेंढा यांनी झाडाभोवती मल्च द्यावे; जर मल्चिंगसाठी सेंद्रीय पदार्थ नसेल तर प्लास्टिक मल्चिंग करण्याचा पर्याय आहे; मल्चिंग करतांना आवश्यक कीटकनाशक पावडर पसरल्यास वाळवी प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.

question: लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळते?
answer:
लहान शेतकऱ्यांना (आपल्यासारख्या ०.५ हे.) अनुदानाची रक्कम जास्त मिळणाऱ्या योजनांची काही उदाहरणे खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (पीएम-किसान):** ही केंद्र सरकारची योजना आहे. या योजनेत **₹६०००** प्रतिवर्षे तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये दिले जातात.

**पात्रता:**
- ७/१२ उतारावर नोंदलेला जमीनधारक शेतकरी
- आधार व बँक खाते लिंक आणि ई-क्युएसी आवश्यक

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** पीएम-किसान पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करता येतो.

---

**नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (एन.एस.एम.एन.वाय.):** ही सुद्धा केंद्र सरकारची योजना आहे आणि पीएम-किसान पात्र लाभार्थ्यांना वेगळ्यापणी दिली जाते. यात पुन्हा **₹६०००** प्रतिवर्षे तीन समान हप्त्यांत मिळतात.

**पात्रता:**  
- पीएम-किसान पात्र लाभार्थी असणे आवश्यक आहे.

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
- वेगळा अर्ज लागत नाही; पीएम-किसान लाभार्थी असल्यास थेट पात्रता लागू होते.

---

**उत्तर भारतीय इतिहास एकीकृत मृदूधरण विकास अभियान - प्रकार-१ ठिबक गोडाम (कूल स्टोरेज, मिशन फॉर इंटिग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर):** हा प्रकार-१ ठिबक गोडामसाठी महत्त्वपूर्ण आहे; पण तो प्रामुख्याने व्यापारी स्तरावरील उद्योग / शेतकरी गटांच्या / फौ.पी.ओ./ स्वयंसहायता गटांकरता (कमाल क्षमतेपर्यंत) दिला जातो आणि त्यासाठी बँक कर्जाशी जोडलेली अनुदान पद्धत असते. म्हणून हा वैयक्तिक लहान शेतकरी घरासाठी सामान्यपणे योग्य नसतो.

**पात्रता:**
- सहकार संस्था, शेतकरी गट, फौ.पी.ओ., स्वयंसहायता गट किंवा इतर मान्यताप्राप्त संघटना (किमान सदस्यता आवश्यक)  
- बँकेचा परवानगी पत्र व तज्ञ अभ्यासाचे प्रमाणपत्र इत्यादी आर्थिक कागदपत्रे आवश्यक

---

**कुलगार यंत्रे अनुदान (सब-मिशन ऑन अॅग्रिकल्चर मेकनायझेशन):** कुलगार यंत्रे खरेदीसाठी अनुदान देते; सामान्यतः अनुसूचित जाती-जमाती, महिला आणि लहान शेतकऱ्यांना **४०%** किंवा सरकारने घातलेल्या कमाल मर्यादेपर्यंत अनुदान मिळू शकते.

**पात्रता:**
- वैयक्तिक शेतकरी  
- यंत्राच्या ओटीत, चाचणी अहवाल, ट्रॅक्टर चालित साधनांसाठी आर.सी. क्रमांक आवश्यक  

---

**नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – विहिरी पूरभरण (विश्वबँक मदतीचे पोक्रा-गावे):** तुमचे गाव पोक्रा-गाव नसेल तर ही योजना तुमच्यासाठी लागू होत नाही.

**पात्रता:**  
- पोक्रा प्रकल्पात समाविष्ट गाव असणे आवश्यक  
- आपल्याला स्वतःची खुडबुडी विहीर असणे आवश्यक  
- जमीन मर्यादा कमाल **५** हे.

---

याशिवाय कोणत्या विशेष गरजेनुसार (उदा. ठिबक सिंचन, शेततळे, कुलगार यंत्रे) अनुदान जास्त मिळणारे पर्याय हवे असतील तर मी त्या विशिष्ट योजनांसाठी अचूक माहिती देऊ शकतो.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुम्हाला ठिबक सिंचन किंवा कुलगार यंत्रे यापैकी कोणत्या बाबीसाठी अनुदान अधिक जाणून घ्यायचे आहे?

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

## 2. Scheme Information

*Id*:
52

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-well-recharge

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Well Recharge

*Sub Component*:
Well Recharge

*Introduction*:
The rate of groundwater extraction is higher than the rate of recharge, and consequently, groundwater is not being replenished in proportion. As a result, the groundwater level has been progressively declining. To raise the groundwater level, it is necessary to make efforts to percolate rainwater wherever possible. Along with this, it is essential to use the available groundwater sparingly and in a scientific manner. To enable farmers to provide protective irrigation to crops, the well recharge component for groundwater replenishment is being implemented as an individual benefit component under the World Bank-aided Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp, to increase water availability in existing wells.

*Benefits*:
1. To empower small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change. 
2. To increase the groundwater level by recharging existing wells used for irrigation in the agricultural sector. 
3. To conserve more water in drought-affected areas and improve the social and economic conditions of the people.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already benefited from any other scheme for this component will not be eligible for benefits under this scheme again.
2. Beneficiary must have own dug well.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, certificate related to that.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"

question: Suryaphulasathi Sulfur cha shifaras kelela dose kiti aahe?
answer:
सुर्यफुलासाठी गंधक (सल्फर) कमी असलेल्या मातीमध्ये शिफारस केलेली मात्रा **८ कि.ग्रा. प्रति एकर** आहे; पेरणीच्या वेळी गांडूळ खत/कंपोस्टमध्ये मिसळून देणे हा उल्लेख आहे.

**माती:** गंधकाची कमतरता असलेल्या जमिनीसाठीच ही शिफारस लागू आहे.  
**खत व्यवस्थापन:** ८ कि.ग्रा. प्रति एकर गंधक पेरणीच्या वेळी गांडूळ खतात मिसळून द्यावे अशी सूचना आहे.  
**पिक नियमितता:** पावसाळी (जिरायती) पिकासाठी २० कि.ग्रा. नत्र, १० कि.ग्रा. स्फुरद व १० कि.ग्रा. पालाश प्रति एकर, तर बागेतील (सिंचित) पिकासाठी २४-२४-२४ कि.ग्रा. प्रति एकर असे रासायनिक खतांचे प्रमाणही दिले आहे.

**स्रोत: एमपीकेव्ही कृषी दर्शन**

**MPKV Research Recommendation 2022 Rahuri**
```
10. Application of recommended dose [मात्रा] of N and P2O5 (50:25 kg ha-1) at sowing [पेरणी] along with sulphur [गंधक] 40 kg ha-1 incubated in one tone FYM 15 days before sowing [पेरणी] is recommended for safflower [करडई] grown on medium deep black sulphur [गंधक] deficient soils in scarcity zone of Maharashtra for higher yield [उत्पादन] and monetary returns.

11. In situ green manuring [हिरवळीचे खत] with black gram [उडीद] during kharif season [खरीप हंगाम] followed by seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] of Azotobactor and Azospirilium @ 25 g kg-1 with 50% RDN (25 kg ), full dose [मात्रा] of P2O5 (25kg) and K2O (25kg) pre hectare at the time of sowing [पेरणी] is recommend for rabi sunflower [सुर्यफुल] grown on medium deep black soil [काळी मृदा] in scarcity zone of Maharashtra for getting higher grain [धान्य] yield [उत्पादन], economic returns with better soil health [मृदा आरोग्य].

12. Application of 40kg ha-1 sulphur [गंधक] with FYM 2.5 ton 15 days before sowing [पेरणी] with recommended dose [मात्रा] of N:P2O5:K (25:50:0)kg ha-1 is recommended for linseed [जवस] grown on medium deep black sulphur [गंधक] deficit soil [माती] in scarcity zone of Maharashtra for higher yield [उत्पादन] and monetary returns.

13. Groundnut [भुईमुग] + Pigeonpea [तूर] (4:2) intercropping system [आंतरपीक पद्धत] and Groundnut [भुईमुग]- Chickpea [हरभरा] cropping systems are recommended to increase the yield [उत्पादन] and monetary returns of kharif groundnut [भुईमुग] in assured rainfall zone of north Maharashtra.

14. Application of 100% RDF(25 kg N/ha+ 50 kg P2O5/ha) to soil [माती] and seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] with bio-grow formulation @ 50 ml/10 kg seed [बियाणे] along with 200 ml water at the time of sowing [पेरणी] is recommended to increase the yield [उत्पादन] and economic returns of summer groundnut [भुईमुग] in Western Maharashtra.

15. Sowing [पेरणी] of Phule Morana / Phule Warana groundnut [भुईमुग] variety with 45 x 10 cm2 spacing [अंतर] and seed rate [बियाण्याची प्रमाण] 67 kg ha-1 is recommended to increase the yield [उत्पादन] and economic returns of kharif groundnut [भुईमुग] in assured rainfall zone of north Maharashtra.

16. Drip fertigation [ठिबक खत व्यवस्थापन] with 80% recommended dose [मात्रा] (80:40:40 NPK kg ha-1) of water soluble fertilizers in 12 weekly splits as per following schedule is recommended for higher yield [उत्पादन], efficient water, nutrient [पोषक घटक] use and higher economical returns from summer okra [भेंडी] cultivated in medium deep soils of western Maharashtra.
```

**MPKV Research Recommendation 2024 Rahuri**
```
18. Split application [विभागणीद्वारे खत देणे] of general recommended dose [मात्रा] of fertilizers (300:200:300 N:P2O5:K2O kg ha-1 + FYM 30 t ha-1) as 60:40:60 N:P2O5:K2O kg ha-1 + FYM 30 t ha-1 at planting and 30:20:30 N:P2O5:K2O kg ha-1 each at one month interval up to 8 months + soil [माती] application of Ferrous sulphate @ 20 kg ha-1 + Zinc sulphate [झिंक सल्फेट] @ 10 kg ha-1 (incubated for 15 days 1:10 proportion in FYM before application in soil [माती]) to tuberose [रजनीगंध] is recommended for higher yield [उत्पादन], quality, nutrient uptake [अन्नद्रव्य सेवन], net monetary returns and maintaining soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता].

19. Seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] of consortium of phosphorus solubilizing bacteria [स्फुरद विरघळविणारे जिवाणू] (Bacillus subtilis, Pseudomonas [स्यूडोमोनास एक सामान्य संक्रामक जीव] fluorescens and Bacillus megaterium) @ 10 g per kg seed [बियाणे] followed by application of 75% recommended dose [मात्रा] of phosphorus [स्फुरद] (56 kg P2O5 ha-1) 100% recommended dose [मात्रा] of nitrogen [नत्र] and potassium [पालाश] (50:45 N:K2O kg ha-1) + FYM 10 t ha-1 is recommended for higher grain [धान्य] yield [उत्पादन] and monetary returns of soybean [सोयाबीन] for Sub-montane Zone of Maharashtra.

20. Application of bentonite sulphur [गंधक] @ 20 kg ha-1 along with general recommended dose [मात्रा] of fertilizer [खत] (50:75:45 N:P2O5:K2O kg + FYM 10 t ha-1) at the time of sowing [पेरणी] to soybean [सोयाबीन] is recommended for higher yield [उत्पादन], better quality, higher monetary returns and for maintaining soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] in sulphur [गंधक] deficient medium deep black soils of Western Maharashtra.

21. Foliar application [पानांवर फवारणी] of Phule Liquid Micro Grade II @ 1.5 % (15 ml L-1) at 60 and 90 days after planting with recommended dose [मात्रा] of fertilizer [खत] to preseasonal sugarcane [ऊस] (340:170:170 N:P2O5:K2O kg ha-1) and ratoon (250:115:115 N:P2O5:K2O kg ha-1) along with 25 t ha-1 FYM for plant cane and recommended trash management [व्यवस्थापन] practice to ratoon is recommended for economically beneficial and higher cane and CCS yield [उत्पादन] of sugarcane [ऊस].
```

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
**Intercropping [आंतरपीक]:** In the intercropping system [आंतरपीक पद्धत], good increase in yield [उत्पादन] is obtained by sowing [पेरणी] sunflower [सुर्यफुल] + tur (2:1 or 2:2) and groundnut [भुईमुग] + sunflower [सुर्यफुल] (6:2 or 3:1) in rows.

**Chemical Fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:** For rainfed crop [पीक], apply 1 ton of farmyard manure [शेणखत] and 20 kg Nitrogen [नत्र], 10 kg Phosphorus [स्फुरद] and 10 kg Potash per acre at the time of sowing [पेरणी] with a two-row seed drill [बियाणे पेरणी यंत्र]. For irrigated crop [पीक], apply 24 kg Nitrogen [नत्र] + 24 kg Phosphorus [स्फुरद] + 24 kg Potash per acre. Out of this, apply 12 kg Nitrogen [नत्र] and all Phosphorus [स्फुरद] and Potash at the time of sowing [पेरणी] and apply the remaining 12 kg Nitrogen [नत्र] within one month after sowing [पेरणी]. For soils deficient in sulphur [गंधक], apply 08 kg sulphur [गंधक] per acre mixed with earthworm compost [गांडूळ खत] at the time of sowing [पेरणी].

**Interculturing:** After sowing [पेरणी], thin the plants to maintain a distance of 30 cm between two plants after 15 to 20 days. Do one hand weeding [निंदन] and two hoeings after sowing [पेरणी]. The first hoeing [डवरणे] should be done 20 days after sowing [पेरणी] and the second hoeing [डवरणे] should be done 35 to 40 days after sowing [पेरणी].

**Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]:** It is very important to irrigate the sunflower [सुर्यफुल] crop [पीक] during sensitive stages. Sensitive stages of sunflower [सुर्यफुल]:

1. Seedling stage [रोपट्याची अवस्था] 2. Bud formation stage 3. Flowering stage 4. Grain filling [दाणे भरणे] stage. Water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] should not be allowed during these sensitive stages. If there is water stress [पाण्याचा ताण] from the bud formation stage to the grain filling [दाणे भरणे] stage, the grains [धान्ये] remain hollow and the production [उत्पादन] decreases.

**Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण]:** Viral disease [विषाणूजन्य रोग] is transmitted through sap sucking thrips [फुलकिडे]. To control them, spray Imidacloprid 17.8% S.L. at 1 ml / 10 liters of water. To control hairy caterpillars, collect the egg masses of the larvae and destroy them by putting them in kerosene mixed water.

**Harvesting [कापणी]:** Harvest [कापणी] the sunflower [सुर्यफुल] crop [पीक] after the leaves, stems and back side of the flower turn yellow. Thresh the cobs after drying [वाळवणे] them well.
```

6. The application of FYM 10 t/ha along with N, P2O5 and K2O @ 50:40:30 kg/ha in which half dose [मात्रा] of N and full dose [मात्रा] of P2O5 and K2O at the time of transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] and remaining half dose [मात्रा] of N at 30 days after transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] is recommended for obtaining the highest marketable dry [कोरडे] herbage yield [उत्पादन] and monitory return of medicinal Tulsi in medium black soils of Western Maharashtra.

7. Application of 10 t FYM ha-1 one month before transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] and 60 kg N, 30 kg P2O5, 4.2 kg Zn (20 kg zinc sulphate [झिंक सल्फेट]) and 0.66 kg B (6 kg borax [बोरॅक्स]) ha-1 through briquettes applied with 5 g guar gum per kg briquettes alongwith 50 kg K2O ha-1 at the time of transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] to lowland paddy is recommended for higher yield [उत्पादन] and net returns in zinc [झिंक] and boron [बोरॉन] deficient soils of Western Ghat Zone of Maharashtra.

8. Application of recommended dose [मात्रा] of N and P2O5 (25:50 kg ha-1) alongwith 5 t FYM and 2% foliar spray [पानांवरील फवारणी] of Diammonium phosphate (DAP) at 50% pod setting [शेंगा भरणे] stage is recommended for chickpea [हरभरा] grown on medium deep black soils in scarcity zone of Maharashtra for higher yield [उत्पादन] and monitory returns.

9. Application of recommended dose [मात्रा] of N and P2O5 (50: 25 kg ha-1) alongwith three foliar sprays of 2% water soluble fertilizer [विद्राव्य खत] 19:19:19 at rosette stage (25-30 DAS), bud initiation stage (45-50 DAS) and flowering stage (55–60 DAS) is recommended for safflower [करडई] grown on medium deep black soils of scarcity zone of Maharashtra at terminal drought [पीक वाढीच्या शेवटी येणारा दुष्काळ] condition for higher yield [उत्पादन] and monitory returns.

10. Application of recommended dose [मात्रा] of N and P2O5 (50:25 kg ha-1) at sowing [पेरणी] along with sulphur [गंधक] 40 kg ha-1 incubated in one tone FYM 15 days before sowing [पेरणी] is recommended for safflower [करडई] grown on medium deep black sulphur [गंधक] deficient soils in scarcity zone of Maharashtra for higher yield [उत्पादन] and monetary returns.
```

_Utility:_ In drought [दुष्काळ]-prone areas, closed beds of 6×3 m size can be prepared for rainwater harvesting [पावसाचे पाणी साठवणे] in medium black soil [काळी मृदा].

    e) Field Efficiency [शेत कार्यक्षमता]: 3 to 3.5 Hectares per day**
8. **Low Horsepower Tractor [ट्रॅक्टर] Operated Phule Multicrop Planter [रोप लावणी यंत्र]  
    _Features:_ a) Sowing [पेरणी] of crops like groundnut [भुईमुग], sunflower [सुर्यफुल], safflower [करडई], soybean [सोयाबीन], sorghum [ज्वारी], maize [मका], wheat [गहू], gram [हरभरा], pigeon pea [तूर], etc., can be done by planting method with this machine.  
    b) The amount of granular fertilizer [दाणेदार खत] can be given as per the recommendation.
